# Drift mode on a controller (runtime/showoff.c showoff_pad -> drift.c drift_pad), one page: new career -> prologue
# free roam.  Driving, D-pad down held 1.5 s: drift mode on ("[drift] ... drift mode on (D-pad down held)"), held
# again: off; a short press while driving is still the game's Career Status (UI_Status_Career.fng); standing, the
# same hold is the trunk ("[showoff] ... step 1"), not drift mode.
#   node web/tools/roam-pair.mjs --solo --a Ann:roam_drift_pad.txt

+8    tap BACK

+240  tap RETURN
+0    waitfng GarageMain.fng 3000
+300  tap LEFT
+60   tap RETURN                      # Career
+300  tap RETURN                      # Start New Career
+0    waitfng UI_EngageMessageDialog.fng 8000

+0    roam waitroam 3000

+0    up UP
+0    down DOWN
+120  up DOWN
+300  log stand
+0    pad DDOWN down
+1500ms pad DDOWN up

+60   log end
+10   quit

{"id": "AT001334", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/tests/srvoracle.c", "originalBytes": 22604, "originalSha256": "9c843ada59c7cfe51c4153c523b7b2b7930caee3f46ca0686cfb1812330f2458", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 22604, "utf8TotalBytes": 22604}

/* srvoracle.c -- differential test of server.dll's lifted code (gen/server)
 * against the ORIGINAL x86 code of the same file under Unicorn.
 *
 *   tests/srvoracle.sh [cases-per-function]     (builds and runs it)
 *
 * The lobby protocol of EA's LAN server is TagField text (KEY=VALUE records
 * in a 12-byte framed message), so the functions under test are the TagField
 * codec the server parses and builds every lobby message with, plus its date
 * helpers.  For every case both sides start from identical guest memory: the
 * module image as module.c maps it (original file, own relocations, base
 * 0x00A00000), a 64 KB scratch region with random records, keys and buffers,
 * and a stack holding the cdecl arguments.  The lifted function runs on the
 * runtime's guest memory, the original under Unicorn on private copies; then
 * eax, edx, esp, the scratch region, the stack and the module's .data/.bss
 * must be bit-identical.  A guest fault (unmapped access) or a call that
 * leaves the tested code (an import) must happen on both sides, at the same
 * address.  Argument types are guesses from the code; a wrong guess still
 * gives a valid comparison (both sides get the same inputs), but it tests
 * inputs the game never passes and leaves the real ones untested: 0x00A03360's
 * are read from its disassembly and its call sites (src, dst, length, format).
 * A case that stops at the original's limit only is run again on the
 * original with a long limit before it counts (the two limits are in
 * different units, see g_budget); once such a re-run still stops at its
 * limit, the function gets no more re-runs.  The lifted code stopping at its
 * limit when the original does not stays a difference: g_budget instructions
 * take the lifted code far less than 1 s, so it went another way (a slower
 * path or a different loop count).  A case that stops at its limit on both
 * sides counts as "loop" and is not compared: a lifted loop that never
 * ends, on inputs where the original runs past g_budget, is not seen.
 *
 * Test-only: Unicorn is GPLv2 and never part of the game binary or the app. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "module.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <setjmp.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <unicorn/unicorn.h>

/* ---- what module.c and the lifted shards need from the runtime --------- */
const uint32_t g_imp_count = 0;
static char g_dll[1024];
int fileio_resolve_game(const char *win, char *out, size_t n){ (void)win; snprintf(out, n, "%s", g_dll); return 1; }
uint32_t call_guest(CPU *c, uint32_t fn, int nargs, const uint32_t *args){ (void)c; (void)fn; (void)nargs; (void)args; return 0; }
uint32_t com_scratch(uint32_t n){ (void)n; return 0; }
void guest_sleep_ns(long ns){ (void)ns; }
uint64_t win32_ext_threads(void){ return 0; }
uint64_t win32_ext_threads_exited(void){ return 0; }
uint32_t win32_heap_live(void){ return 0; }
int win32_tls_in_use(void){ return 0; }
int win32_obj_live(void){ return 0; }
uint32_t module_map_for_test(const char *name);
void mem_init(void); void mem_commit(uint32_t, uint32_t);

static sigjmp_buf g_jb;
static volatile uint32_t g_left_at;          /* lifted: target of a call out of the module */
static volatile uint32_t g_fault_at;
guest_fn_t g_dtab[DISPATCH_TEXT_SIZE];      /* empty: every indirect call comes here */
void dispatch_indirect(CPU *c, uint32_t a){
    mod_fn f = module_fn_at(a);
    if (f){ f(c); return; }
    g_left_at = a; siglongjmp(g_jb, 2);
}
void unsupported_insn(CPU *c, uint32_t a, const char *mn){ (void)c; (void)mn; g_left_at = a; siglongjmp(g_jb, 3); }
static void on_fault(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *uc){
    (void)sig; (void)uc;
    g_fault_at = (uint32_t)((uint8_t *)si->si_addr - g_mem);
    siglongjmp(g_jb, 1);
}
/* a case that does not return within the budget (both sides): "loop" */
static void on_alarm(int sig){ (void)sig; g_left_at = 0; siglongjmp(g_jb, 4); }

/* ---- layout ------------------------------------------------------------- */
#define IMG    0x00A00000u
#define DATA   0x00A41000u                   /* .data + BSS, the writable part */
#define DATASZ 0x00014000u
#define SCR    0x20000000u
#define SCRSZ  0x00010000u
#define STK    0x30000000u
#define STKSZ  0x00010000u
#define ESP0   (STK + STKSZ - 0x1000u)
#define RETMAGIC 0x3000FFF0u                 /* return address: mapped, never executed */

static uint8_t *g_img0;                      /* the freshly mapped image */
/* The two sides' limits are in different units: the original stops after
 * g_budget Unicorn instructions, the lifted code after g_lift_s seconds of
 * wall clock.  A case whose length falls between the two stops on one side
 * only, and which side depends on the build's speed: 0x00A03360 given a
 * pointer as its length (by an argument order this test once had wrong) ran
 * about 23G instructions, which the -O3 lifted code finished in 0.9 s, under
 * its 1 s, while Unicorn stopped at 30M.  Such
 * a case is run again on the original, from the same inputs, with g_long_s
 * seconds (Unicorn without an instruction count), and only then compared. */
static size_t g_budget = 30000000u;           /* Unicorn instructions per case (ORACLE_BUDGET) */
static int g_lift_s = 1;                      /* lifted: seconds per case before it counts as a loop */
static int g_long_s = 120;                    /* the original's re-run, seconds (ORACLE_LONG_S, 0: no re-run) */
static uc_engine *g_uc;

/* ---- random inputs ------------------------------------------------------ */
static uint64_t g_rs = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
static uint32_t rnd(void){ g_rs ^= g_rs << 13; g_rs ^= g_rs >> 7; g_rs ^= g_rs << 17; return (uint32_t)(g_rs >> 16); }
static const char *const KEYS[] = { "NAME", "PERS", "ADDR", "PORT", "MID", "MAC", "LANG", "SKU", "VERS", "A",
                                    "name", "Name", "LADDR", "ROOM", "X", "USERS", "PRIV", "B" };
#define NKEYS (int)(sizeof KEYS / sizeof KEYS[0])
static int put_value(char *p, int cap){
    char tmp[256]; int n = 0;
    switch (rnd() % 9){
    case 0: n = snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%d", (int)rnd() - (int)(rnd() & 0x7fffffff)); break;
    case 1: n = snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%u.%u.%u.%u", rnd() % 300, rnd() % 256, rnd() % 256, rnd() % 256); break;
    case 2: n = snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "\"%s %d\"", KEYS[rnd() % NKEYS], (int)(rnd() % 1000)); break;
    case 3: n = snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%%%02x%%%02xabc%%", rnd() & 255, rnd() & 255); break;
    case 4: n = snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "0x%x", rnd()); break;
    case 5: n = snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "+%u", rnd() % 100000); break;
    case 6: { int l = (int)(rnd() % 40); for (n = 0; n < l; n++) tmp[n] = (char)(0x21 + rnd() % 94); tmp[n] = 0; break; }
    case 7: { int l = (int)(rnd() % 12); for (n = 0; n < l; n++) tmp[n] = (char)(1 + rnd() % 255); tmp[n] = 0; break; }
    default: n = snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s", KEYS[rnd() % NKEYS]); break;
    }
    if (n >= cap) n = cap - 1;
    if (n < 0) n = 0;
    memcpy(p, tmp, (size_t)n); p[n] = 0;
    return n;
}
static void put_record(char *p, int cap){
    int k = 0, nf = (int)(rnd() % 12);
    static const char *const SEP[] = { " ", "\n", "\t", "  ", "\r\n", "" };
    for (int f = 0; f < nf && k < cap - 300; f++){
        k += snprintf(p + k, (size_t)(cap - k), "%s%s%c", KEYS[rnd() % NKEYS], rnd() % 7 ? "" : " ", rnd() % 5 ? '=' : ':');
        k += put_value(p + k, cap - k);
        k += snprintf(p + k, (size_t)(cap - k), "%s", SEP[rnd() % 6]);
    }
    p[k] = 0;
}
static int32_t rnd_len(void){
    static const int32_t L[] = { -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 16, 31, 64, 100, 256, 600, 2000 };
    return L[rnd() % (sizeof L / sizeof L[0])];
}

/* ---- functions under test ------------------------------------------------
 * spec letters, one per cdecl argument:
 *   r  record buffer (2 KB, writable, random record)   s  random value string
 *   k  key string                                       b  2 KB buffer, random bytes
 *   n  length (also <= 0, > buffer)                     i  random int
 *   f  structure format as 0x00A03360 reads it: the game's own ("l*",
 *      "16sllll36s", ...) or tokens [count]b|w|l|a|s, '*' after one at times
 *   z  NULL or a pointer into the first record          v  random 32-bit value
 *   t  a date as six dwords (second ... year)
 * "regs": the same letters for eax and ebx, for EA's register-passing helpers. */
typedef struct { uint32_t va; const char *name, *spec, *regs; } Target;   /* regs: eax, ebx spec letters */
static const Target T[] = {
    { 0x00A01D70u, "7-bit varint decode",           "n",      "bb" },   /* eax = src, ebx = dst, count */
    { 0x00A01DC0u, "append raw field",              "rns",    0    },
    { 0x00A02000u, "TagFieldFind",                  "rk",     0    },
    { 0x00A020D0u, "find next (?)",                 "rzk",    0    },
    { 0x00A021B0u, "TagFieldDelete",                "rk",     0    },
    { 0x00A02230u, "strnzcpy",                      "bns",    0    },
    { 0x00A02270u, "get token (?)",                 "rbn",    0    },
    { 0x00A02310u, "set number (?)",                "rnki",   0    },
    { 0x00A023E0u, "set address/flags (?)",         "rnki",   0    },
    { 0x00A02490u, "set string (?)",                "rnks",   0    },
    { 0x00A02BB0u, "set (?)",                       "rnks",   0    },
    { 0x00A02BF0u, "dupl/merge (?)",                "rns",    0    },
    { 0x00A02E80u, "TagFieldGetNumber",             "si",     0    },
    { 0x00A02ED0u, "TagFieldGetFlags",              "si",     0    },
    { 0x00A02F10u, "TagFieldGetAddress",            "si",     0    },
    { 0x00A02F60u, "TagFieldGetString/Delim (?)",   "sbnsii", 0    },
    { 0x00A030F0u, "get binary (?)",                "sbni",   0    },
    { 0x00A03280u, "get structure (?)",             "sbn",    0    },
    { 0x00A03360u, "structure format",              "sbnf",   0    },   /* src, dst, length, format */
    { 0x00A03870u, "compare (?)",                   "ss",     0    },
    { 0x00A01B90u, "date: seconds -> struct",       "b",      "v"  },    /* eax = seconds */
    { 0x00A04F70u, "date: format (?)",              "bbn",    0    },
};
#define NT (int)(sizeof T / sizeof T[0])

static uint32_t g_args[8]; static int g_nargs; static uint32_t g_reg[2];   /* eax, ebx */
static void make_case(const Target *t){
    memset(g_mem + SCR, 0, SCRSZ);
    memset(g_mem + STK, 0, STKSZ);
    uint32_t next = SCR + 0x1000u, rec0 = 0;
    g_nargs = 0;
    char spec[16]; snprintf(spec, sizeof spec, "%s%s", t->regs ? t->regs : "", t->spec);
    int nreg = t->regs ? (int)strlen(t->regs) : 0;
    for (const char *p = spec; *p; p++){
        uint32_t v = 0;
        switch (*p){
        case 'r': put_record((char *)(g_mem + next), 0x800); v = next; if (!rec0) rec0 = next; next += 0x1000u; break;
        case 'b': for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 0x800u; i++) MR8(next + i) = (uint8_t)rnd(); v = next; next += 0x1000u; break;
        case 's': put_value((char *)(g_mem + next), 0x200); if (rnd() % 3 == 0) put_record((char *)(g_mem + next), 0x800);
                  v = next; next += 0x1000u; break;
        case 'k': snprintf((char *)(g_mem + next), 64, "%s", rnd() % 9 ? KEYS[rnd() % NKEYS] : ""); v = next; next += 0x100u; break;
        case 'n': v = (uint32_t)rnd_len(); break;
        case 'f': {   /* a structure format: in a third of the cases one the game passes (its call sites), else
                       * [count]b|w|l|a|s ..., '*' after one at times (repeat it to the end), sometimes "#NAME=" first */
            static const char *const GAMEF[] = { "l*", "l", "llll16sl16s68s68s20s", "lll36s72s20slllll36s132sllll",
                                                 "l36s", "16sllll36s" };
            static const unsigned SLEN[] = { 16, 20, 36, 68, 72, 132 };   /* the game's 's' counts */
            char *f = (char *)(g_mem + next); int k = 0;
            if (rnd() % 3 == 0) k = snprintf(f, 64, "%s", GAMEF[rnd() % 6]);
            else {
                int nt = (int)(rnd() % 8);
                if (rnd() % 4 == 0) k += snprintf(f + k, 16, "#%s=", KEYS[rnd() % NKEYS]);
                for (int q = 0; q < nt; q++){
                    char ty = "bwlas"[rnd() % 5];
                    if (ty == 's' && rnd() % 2) k += snprintf(f + k, 8, "%u", SLEN[rnd() % 6]);
                    else if (rnd() % 2) k += snprintf(f + k, 8, "%u", rnd() % 12);
                    f[k++] = ty;
                    if (rnd() % 6 == 0) f[k++] = '*';
                }
            }
            f[k] = 0; v = next; next += 0x100u; break; }
        case 'i': v = rnd() % 4 ? rnd() % 1000 : rnd(); break;
        case 'z': v = rnd() % 2 || !rec0 ? 0u : rec0 + rnd() % 64; break;
        case 'v': v = rnd() ^ (rnd() << 16); break;
        case 't': {   /* a plausible date: sec, min, hour, day, month, year (1971-2037) */
            static const uint32_t lim[6] = { 60, 60, 24, 28, 12, 67 }, add[6] = { 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1971 };
            for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) MR32(next + 4u*f) = add[f] + rnd() % lim[f];
            v = next; next += 0x100u; break; }
        }
        if (p - spec < nreg) g_reg[p - spec] = v; else g_args[g_nargs++] = v;
    }
    if (!t->regs) g_reg[0] = g_reg[1] = 0;
    else if (nreg < 2) g_reg[1] = 0;
}

typedef struct { uint32_t eax, edx, esp; int how; uint32_t where; } Out;   /* how: 0 ret, 1 fault, 2 left, 3 trap, 4 loop */
static uint8_t g_lsave_data[DATASZ], g_lsave_scr[SCRSZ], g_lsave_stk[STKSZ];
static uint8_t g_usave_data[DATASZ], g_usave_scr[SCRSZ], g_usave_stk[STKSZ];
static uint8_t g_in_scr[SCRSZ], g_in_stk[STKSZ];   /* the case's inputs, for a re-run (.data: g_img0) */

/* x87 control word of both sides: ORACLE_FCW, default 0x027F (PC=53), what
 * the DLL's threads start with on Windows and in the runtime; gen.sh lifts
 * server.dll with the exe's X87PC mode, so the precision control matters */
static uint16_t g_fcw = 0x027f;
static Out run_lifted(uint32_t va, int secs){
    static CPU c; Out o = {0};
    memset(&c, 0, sizeof c); c.fcw = g_fcw; c.esp = ESP0; c.eax = g_reg[0]; c.ebx = g_reg[1];
    for (int i = g_nargs - 1; i >= 0; i--){ c.esp -= 4; MR32(c.esp) = g_args[i]; }
    c.esp -= 4; MR32(c.esp) = RETMAGIC;
    mod_fn f = module_fn_at(va);
    struct itimerval it = { {0, 0}, {secs, 0} }, off = { {0, 0}, {0, 0} };
    int r = sigsetjmp(g_jb, 1);
    if (r == 0){ setitimer(ITIMER_REAL, &it, 0); f(&c); o.how = 0; o.where = c.eip; }
    else { o.how = r; o.where = r == 1 ? g_fault_at : g_left_at; }
    setitimer(ITIMER_REAL, &off, 0);
    o.eax = c.eax; o.edx = c.edx; o.esp = c.esp;
    return o;
}

static uint32_t g_ufault;
static bool on_umem(uc_engine *uc, uc_mem_type t, uint64_t a, int sz, int64_t v, void *u){
    (void)uc; (void)t; (void)sz; (void)v; (void)u; g_ufault = (uint32_t)a; return false;
}
/* long_s 0: at most g_budget instructions; else no instruction count and a
 * time limit of long_s seconds */
static Out run_unicorn(uint32_t va, int long_s){
    Out o = {0};
    uc_mem_write(g_uc, DATA, g_mem + DATA, DATASZ);
    uc_mem_write(g_uc, SCR, g_mem + SCR, SCRSZ);
    uc_mem_write(g_uc, STK, g_mem + STK, STKSZ);
    uint32_t esp = ESP0, z = 0, ef = 0x202;
    for (int i = g_nargs - 1; i >= 0; i--){ esp -= 4; uc_mem_write(g_uc, esp, &g_args[i], 4); }
    esp -= 4; { uint32_t ra = RETMAGIC; uc_mem_write(g_uc, esp, &ra, 4); }
    int regs[] = { UC_X86_REG_EAX, UC_X86_REG_EBX, UC_X86_REG_ECX, UC_X86_REG_EDX, UC_X86_REG_ESI, UC_X86_REG_EDI, UC_X86_REG_EBP };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof regs / sizeof regs[0]; i++) uc_reg_write(g_uc, regs[i], &z);
    uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EAX, &g_reg[0]); uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EBX, &g_reg[1]);
    uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_ESP, &esp);
    uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EFLAGS, &ef);
    { uint32_t cw = g_fcw; uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_FPCW, &cw); }
    g_ufault = 0;
    uc_err e = uc_emu_start(g_uc, va, RETMAGIC, long_s ? (uint64_t)long_s * 1000000u : 0, long_s ? 0 : g_budget);
    /* blocks translated without the instruction count would be reused by the
     * next counted run, which then never stops (seen: 31 minutes): drop them */
    if (long_s) uc_ctl_flush_tb(g_uc);
    uint32_t eip = 0;
    uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EIP, &eip);
    uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EAX, &o.eax); uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EDX, &o.edx);
    uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_ESP, &o.esp);
    if (e == UC_ERR_OK && eip == RETMAGIC){ o.how = 0; o.where = eip; }
    else if (e == UC_ERR_FETCH_UNMAPPED){ o.how = 2; o.where = eip; }          /* an import (IMP_MAGIC) */
    else if (e == UC_ERR_READ_UNMAPPED || e == UC_ERR_WRITE_UNMAPPED){ o.how = 1; o.where = g_ufault; }
    else if (e == UC_ERR_OK){ o.how = 4; o.where = 0; }                            /* budget or time used up */
    else { o.how = 9; o.where = eip; fprintf(stderr, "  unicorn: %s at 0x%08x\n", uc_strerror(e), eip); }
    uc_mem_read(g_uc, DATA, g_usave_data, DATASZ);
    uc_mem_read(g_uc, SCR, g_usave_scr, SCRSZ);
    uc_mem_read(g_uc, STK, g_usave_stk, STKSZ);
    return o;
}

static int first_diff(const uint8_t *a, const uint8_t *b, uint32_t n){
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (a[i] != b[i]) return (int)i;
    return -1;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv){
    const char *dll = getenv("SRVDLL");
    int ncase = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 2000;
    if (!dll){ fprintf(stderr, "SRVDLL=<path to server.dll> required\n"); return 2; }
    snprintf(g_dll, sizeof g_dll, "%s", dll);
    mem_init();
    if (!module_map_for_test("server.dll")){ fprintf(stderr, "srvoracle: server.dll could not be mapped\n"); return 2; }
    mem_commit(SCR, SCRSZ); mem_commit(STK, STKSZ);
    g_img0 = malloc(DATASZ); memcpy(g_img0, g_mem + DATA, DATASZ);
    struct sigaction sa; memset(&sa, 0, sizeof sa); sa.sa_sigaction = on_fault; sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
    sigaction(SIGSEGV, &sa, 0); sigaction(SIGBUS, &sa, 0);
    signal(SIGALRM, on_alarm);
    setvbuf(stdout, 0, _IOLBF, 0);

    if (uc_open(UC_ARCH_X86, UC_MODE_32, &g_uc) != UC_ERR_OK){ fprintf(stderr, "uc_open failed\n"); return 2; }
    uc_mem_map(g_uc, IMG, 0x58000u, UC_PROT_ALL);
    uc_mem_write(g_uc, IMG, g_mem + IMG, 0x58000u);
    uc_mem_map(g_uc, SCR, SCRSZ, UC_PROT_ALL);
    uc_mem_map(g_uc, STK, STKSZ, UC_PROT_ALL);
    uc_hook hk; uc_hook_add(g_uc, &hk, UC_HOOK_MEM_READ_UNMAPPED | UC_HOOK_MEM_WRITE_UNMAPPED, (void *)on_umem, 0, 1, 0);

    int total_diff = 0, reruns = 0;
    printf("server.dll differential test: lifted C vs original x86 (Unicorn), %d cases per function\n", ncase);
    printf("  %-10s %-30s %7s %7s %6s %6s %6s %6s\n", "function", "", "cases", "same", "fault", "left", "loop", "DIFF");
    if (getenv("ORACLE_BUDGET")) g_budget = (size_t)strtoull(getenv("ORACLE_BUDGET"), 0, 0);
    if (getenv("ORACLE_LONG_S")) g_long_s = atoi(getenv("ORACLE_LONG_S"));
    if (g_long_s < 0) g_long_s = 0;
    if (getenv("ORACLE_FCW")) g_fcw = (uint16_t)strtoul(getenv("ORACLE_FCW"), 0, 0);
    printf("  x87 control word 0x%04x on both sides (PC=%d)\n", g_fcw, (g_fcw >> 8 & 3) == 0 ? 24 : (g_fcw >> 8 & 3) == 2 ? 53 : 64);
    const char *only = getenv("ORACLE_FNS");
    for (int t = 0; t < NT; t++){
        if (only){ char h[16]; snprintf(h, sizeof h, "%x", T[t].va); if (!strstr(only, h)) continue; }
        int same = 0, fault = 0, left = 0, loop = 0, diff = 0, shown = 0, rerun = g_long_s > 0;
        g_rs = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull ^ T[t].va;
        for (int k = 0; k < ncase; k++){
            memcpy(g_mem + DATA, g_img0, DATASZ);
            make_case(&T[t]);
            memcpy(g_in_scr, g_mem + SCR, SCRSZ); memcpy(g_in_stk, g_mem + STK, STKSZ);
            /* Unicorn first: it works on copies of the very inputs */
            Out u = run_unicorn(T[t].va, 0);
            Out l = run_lifted(T[t].va, g_lift_s);
            memcpy(g_lsave_data, g_mem + DATA, DATASZ);
            memcpy(g_lsave_scr, g_mem + SCR, SCRSZ);
            memcpy(g_lsave_stk, g_mem + STK, STKSZ);
            if (rerun && u.how == 4 && l.how != 4){
                /* the original stopped at its instruction count: again, from the same inputs, with the long limit */
                memcpy(g_mem + DATA, g_img0, DATASZ); memcpy(g_mem + SCR, g_in_scr, SCRSZ); memcpy(g_mem + STK, g_in_stk, STKSZ);
                u = run_unicorn(T[t].va, g_long_s);
                reruns++;
                if (u.how == 4) rerun = 0;   /* still at the long limit: no more for this function */
                fprintf(stderr, "  re-run %08x case %d, the original with %d s: lifted how=%d eax=%08x edx=%08x | "
                                "original how=%d eax=%08x edx=%08x\n", T[t].va, k, g_long_s, l.how, l.eax, l.edx,
                        u.how, u.eax, u.edx);
            }
            const char *why = 0; int at = -1;
            if (u.how != l.how) why = "outcome";
            else if (u.how == 1 || u.how == 2){ if (u.where != l.where) why = "where"; }
            else if (u.how == 0){
                if (u.eax != l.eax) why = "eax";
                else if (u.edx != l.edx) why = "edx";
                else if (u.esp != l.esp) why = "esp";
                else if ((at = first_diff(g_lsave_scr, g_usave_scr, SCRSZ)) >= 0) why = "scratch";
                else if ((at = first_diff(g_lsave_stk + 0, g_usave_stk + 0, STKSZ)) >= 0) why = "stack";
                else if ((at = first_diff(g_lsave_data, g_usave_data, DATASZ)) >= 0) why = "data";
            }
            if (why){
                diff++;
                if (shown++ < 3){
                    fprintf(stderr, "  DIFF %08x case %d (%s): lifted how=%d at=%08x eax=%08x edx=%08x esp=%08x | "
                                    "original how=%d at=%08x eax=%08x edx=%08x esp=%08x", T[t].va, k, why,
                            l.how, l.where, l.eax, l.edx, l.esp, u.how, u.where, u.eax, u.edx, u.esp);
                    if (at >= 0) fprintf(stderr, " first byte +0x%x", at);
                    fprintf(stderr, "\n    args:");
                    for (int i = 0; i < g_nargs; i++) fprintf(stderr, " %08x", g_args[i]);
                    fprintf(stderr, "\n");
                }
            } else if (u.how == 0) same++;
            else if (u.how == 1) fault++;
            else if (u.how == 4) loop++;
            else left++;
        }
        total_diff += diff;
        printf("  %08x   %-30s %7d %7d %6d %6d %6d %6d\n", T[t].va, T[t].name, ncase, same, fault, left, loop, diff);
    }
    printf("  re-runs with the %d s limit: %d\n", g_long_s, reruns);
    printf("result: %s (%d differing cases)\n", total_diff ? "FAIL" : "PASS", total_diff);
    uc_close(g_uc);
    return total_diff ? 1 : 0;
}

/* watchdog_unit.c -- tests for runtime/watchdog.c without the game.
 *
 *   clang -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Iruntime -o out/watchdog_unit tests/watchdog_unit.c
 *   out/watchdog_unit                          (about 8 s)
 *
 * The watchdog compares its own clock with stamps other threads took: the
 * last Present (game thread) and each guest thread's since_us.  In the
 * browser those threads are other workers, and a stamp taken a moment ago
 * can read a little ahead of the watchdog's now; 2026-10-25/26 logs had
 * "[watchdog] no Present for 18446744073709.6 s" (2^64 us) from that.
 * Cases, on the real watchdog thread (NFSU2_WATCHDOG=1; no guest memory, so
 * game flow 0 and the loading screen's limit of 20 s):
 *   ahead-us   the game thread keeps stamping a few microseconds ahead: no report
 *   ahead-s    a stamp 2 s ahead: no report
 *   stall      the last Present 25 s ago: one report, "no Present for 25..28 s",
 *              a thread whose since_us is ahead reads "for 0.0 s"
 *   short      5 s ago (under the limit): no report
 *   download   the page's Download log: a stamp ahead is "0.0 s ago" and no
 *              report; 5 s ago is "5.0 s ago" with the report
 * Every case prints "PASS <case> ..." or "FAIL <case> ..."; exit 1 on a FAIL. */
#include "../runtime/watchdog.c"
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>

/* ---- stand-ins for win32_ext.c, mem.c and debug.c ------------------------- */
TState   g_tstate[MAXCPUS];
CPU     *g_all_cpus[MAXCPUS];
uint32_t g_all_tids[MAXCPUS];
int      g_all_n;
CPU     *g_cur_cpu;
uint8_t  g_cbits[1u << 15] = {0};               /* nothing committed: game flow reads 0 */
uint8_t *g_mem;
void guest_backtrace(CPU *c, int n){ (void)c; (void)n; }
int  win32_cs_held(uint32_t *key, uint32_t *owner, int *depth, int max){ return 0; }
int  win32_obj_describe(uint32_t h, char *buf, size_t n){ return snprintf(buf, n, "handle 0x%08x", h); }

static int g_fail;
#define CHECK(cond, ...) do{ if (cond) printf("PASS " __VA_ARGS__); else { printf("FAIL " __VA_ARGS__); g_fail = 1; } \
                             printf("\n"); fflush(stdout); }while(0)

/* stderr goes to a file; err_since() returns what was written after a mark */
static FILE *g_err;
static off_t g_mark;
static off_t err_size(void){ struct stat st; fflush(stderr); return fstat(fileno(g_err), &st) == 0 ? st.st_size : 0; }
static void err_mark(void){ g_mark = err_size(); }
static char *err_since(void){
    static char buf[16384];
    size_t n = (size_t)(err_size() - g_mark);
    if (n >= sizeof buf) n = sizeof buf - 1;
    ssize_t got = pread(fileno(g_err), buf, n, g_mark);
    buf[got > 0 ? got : 0] = 0;
    return buf;
}
static void wait_ms(int ms){ struct timespec t = { ms / 1000, (ms % 1000) * 1000000L }; nanosleep(&t, 0); }

/* the game thread presenting with its clock a few microseconds ahead */
static _Atomic int g_stamping;
static void *stamper(void *arg){
    (void)arg;
    while (atomic_load(&g_stamping)) atomic_store(&g_wd_present_us, wd_now_us() + 5);
    return 0;
}
/* guest thread 0 stamping its since_us as far ahead, until the report has read
 * it: a stamp taken once would read as old as the wait for the watchdog's next
 * tick (0..1 s) */
static _Atomic int g_tstamping;
static void *tstamper(void *arg){
    (void)arg;
    while (atomic_load(&g_tstamping)) g_tstate[0].since_us = wd_now_us() + 5;
    return 0;
}

int main(void){
    g_err = tmpfile();
    if (!g_err || dup2(fileno(g_err), 2) < 0){ printf("FAIL setup: no temporary file for stderr\n"); return 1; }
    setvbuf(stderr, 0, _IONBF, 0);
    static CPU cpu;
    g_all_cpus[0] = &cpu; g_all_tids[0] = 101; g_all_n = 1;
    g_tstate[0].what = TS_WAIT; g_tstate[0].obj = 0x00A00002u;

    setenv("NFSU2_WATCHDOG", "1", 1);
    watchdog_start();

    /* ahead-us: what the browser does now and then, kept up for two ticks */
    err_mark();
    atomic_store(&g_stamping, 1);
    pthread_t th; pthread_create(&th, 0, stamper, 0);
    wait_ms(2500);
    atomic_store(&g_stamping, 0); pthread_join(th, 0);
    CHECK(watchdog_reports() == 0 && !strstr(err_since(), "no Present"),
          "ahead-us: stamps 5 us ahead for 2.5 s give no report (%llu reports)", (unsigned long long)watchdog_reports());

    /* ahead-s: a stamp well ahead */
    err_mark();
    atomic_store(&g_wd_present_us, wd_now_us() + 2000000u);
    wait_ms(2500);
    CHECK(watchdog_reports() == 0 && !strstr(err_since(), "no Present"),
          "ahead-s: a stamp 2 s ahead gives no report (%llu reports)", (unsigned long long)watchdog_reports());

    /* stall: a real one still reports, once */
    err_mark();
    atomic_store(&g_tstamping, 1);                  /* this thread's own stamp, ahead as well */
    pthread_create(&th, 0, tstamper, 0);
    atomic_store(&g_wd_present_us, wd_now_us() - 25000000u);
    for (int i = 0; i < 30 && watchdog_reports() == 0; i++) wait_ms(100);
    wait_ms(1500);                                  /* a second tick: still one report */
    atomic_store(&g_tstamping, 0); pthread_join(th, 0);
    {   const char *e = err_since(); double s = -1, f = -1;
        const char *p = strstr(e, "no Present for "), *q = strstr(e, "waiting on ");
        if (p) sscanf(p, "no Present for %lf", &s);
        if (q && (q = strstr(q, " for "))) sscanf(q, " for %lf", &f);
        CHECK(watchdog_reports() == 1 && s >= 25.0 && s < 28.0,
              "stall: 25 s without a Present reports once (%llu reports, %.1f s)", (unsigned long long)watchdog_reports(), s);
        CHECK(f == 0.0, "stall: a thread stamp ahead reads 0.0 s in the report (%.1f s)", f); }

    /* short: under the loading screen's 20 s */
    err_mark();
    atomic_store(&g_wd_present_us, wd_now_us() - 5000000u);
    wait_ms(1500);
    CHECK(watchdog_reports() == 1 && !strstr(err_since(), "no Present"),
          "short: 5 s without a Present gives no report (%llu reports)", (unsigned long long)watchdog_reports());

    /* download: the page's Download log */
    err_mark();
    atomic_store(&g_wd_present_us, wd_now_us() + 5);
    watchdog_log_download();
    {   const char *e = err_since();
        CHECK(strstr(e, "the last frame 0.0 s ago") && !strstr(e, "no Present") && watchdog_reports() == 1,
              "download: a stamp ahead is 0.0 s ago, no report"); }
    err_mark();
    g_tstate[0].since_us = wd_now_us() + 5;
    atomic_store(&g_wd_present_us, wd_now_us() - 5000000u);
    watchdog_log_download();
    {   const char *e = err_since(); double f = -1;
        const char *q = strstr(e, "waiting on ");
        if (q && (q = strstr(q, " for "))) sscanf(q, " for %lf", &f);
        CHECK(strstr(e, "the last frame 5.0 s ago") && strstr(e, "no Present for 5.0 s") && watchdog_reports() == 2 && f == 0.0,
              "download: 5 s ago is reported, the thread stamp ahead reads 0.0 s (%.1f s)", f); }

    printf(g_fail ? "watchdog unit tests: FAILED\n" : "watchdog unit tests: all passed\n");
    return g_fail;
}

{"id": "AT001337", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/tests/web/aliastest.c", "originalBytes": 4790, "originalSha256": "2a5fb8fa7222d5e429ceaad6ebc14cf6ef5f10a959ab837711efda774ed72040", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 4790, "utf8TotalBytes": 4790}

/* Guest memory is untyped (web/tools/aliastest.sh).
 * x86 code moves floats through integer registers all the time; MSVC returns
 * a float vector by value like this:
 *     sub  esp,10h ; ... ; fstp dword [esp+8] ; mov edx,[esp+8] ; mov [ecx+8],edx
 * The lifted C for that is an MRF32 store and an MR32 load of one guest
 * address.  If the compiler may assume float and uint32_t accesses never
 * alias, it can move the load above the store and copy a stale value.
 * clang 23's wasm backend did that in the game's vector normalize (0x4870B0)
 * until runtime/cpu.h gave the guest accesses may_alias types.
 * vnorm() is a vector normalize written the same way (lifted style, built with
 * web/build.sh's flags); main() checks its result.  It also builds natively
 * (clang -O3 -mcpu=apple-m1 -Iruntime tests/web/aliastest.c): Apple clang's
 * arm64 code passes with the Mac's plain-typed macros too. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>

#define ONE 0x00100200u                      /* a guest constant 1.0f */
/* this = ecx (x, y, z), [esp+4] = out; returns out in eax; ret 4 */
__attribute__((noinline)) void vnorm(CPU *restrict c){
    { uint32_t _a=c->esp,_b=0x10u,_r=_a-_b; FLAGS_SUB_M(_a,_b,_r,32,0x00u); c->esp = (uint32_t)(_r); }
    FPUSH((double)MRF32(c->ecx+0x8u));
    c->eax = MR32(c->esp+0x14u);
    FPUSH((double)MRF32(c->ecx+0x4u));
    FPUSH((double)MRF32(c->ecx));
    FPUSH(ST(0));
    { double _d=ST(0), _s=ST(1); ST(0)=X87R(x87_r2(_d,_s,_d * _s)); }
    FPUSH(ST(2));
    { double _d=ST(0), _s=ST(3); ST(0)=X87R(x87_r2(_d,_s,_d * _s)); }
    { double _d=ST(1), _s=ST(0); ST(1)=X87R(x87_r2(_d,_s,_d + _s)); }
    FPOP();
    FPUSH(ST(3));
    { double _d=ST(0), _s=ST(4); ST(0)=X87R(x87_r2(_d,_s,_d * _s)); }
    { double _d=ST(1), _s=ST(0); ST(1)=X87R(x87_r2(_d,_s,_d + _s)); }
    FPOP();
    { double _a=ST(0); ST(0)=X87R(x87_r1(_a, sqrt(_a))); }
    ST(3) = ST(0);
    FPOP(); FPOP(); FPOP();
    { double _d=ST(0), _s=((double)MRF32(ONE)); ST(0)=X87R(x87_r2(_d,_s,_s / _d)); }
    FPUSH(ST(0));
    { double _d=ST(0), _s=(double)MRF32(c->ecx); ST(0)=X87R(x87_r2(_d,_s,_d * _s)); }
    MRF32(c->esp) = (float)ST(0);
    FPOP();
    c->edx = MR32(c->esp);
    FPUSH(ST(0));
    { double _d=ST(0), _s=(double)MRF32(c->ecx+0x4u); ST(0)=X87R(x87_r2(_d,_s,_d * _s)); }
    MRF32(c->esp+0x4u) = (float)ST(0);
    FPOP();
    { double _d=ST(0), _s=(double)MRF32(c->ecx+0x8u); ST(0)=X87R(x87_r2(_d,_s,_d * _s)); }
    c->ecx = c->eax;
    MR32(c->ecx) = c->edx;
    c->edx = MR32(c->esp+0x4u);
    MR32(c->ecx+0x4u) = c->edx;
    MRF32(c->esp+0x8u) = (float)ST(0);      /* fstp dword [esp+8] */
    FPOP();
    c->edx = MR32(c->esp+0x8u);             /* mov edx,[esp+8]    */
    MR32(c->ecx+0x8u) = c->edx;
    c->edx = MR32(c->esp+0xcu);
    MR32(c->ecx+0xcu) = c->edx;
    { uint32_t _a=c->esp,_b=0x10u,_r=_a+_b; FLAGS_ADD_M(_a,_b,_r,32,0x3fu); c->esp = (uint32_t)(_r); }
    POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 4u;
}

#ifndef __wasm__
uint8_t *g_mem;                              /* the Mac: guest base pointer */
#include <stdlib.h>
#endif
/* what cpu.h declares for the lifted code; vnorm needs none of it */
void dispatch_indirect(CPU *c, uint32_t a){ (void)c; (void)a; }
void dispatch_tail(CPU *c){ (void)c; }

int main(void){
    static CPU cpu; CPU *c = &cpu;
#ifndef __wasm__
    g_mem = calloc(1, 0x00300000u);
#endif
    const uint32_t V = 0x00100000u, OUT = 0x00100100u, SP = 0x00200000u;
    int fail = 0;
    static const float in[][3] = { {3, 0, 4}, {0, 0, 2}, {1, 2, 2}, {-6, 8, 0}, {0.5f, -0.5f, 0.5f} };
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < sizeof in / sizeof in[0]; k++){
        memset(c, 0, sizeof *c);
        c->fcw = 0x027F;                         /* PC=53, RC=nearest */
        MRF32(ONE) = 1.0f;
        MRF32(V) = in[k][0]; MRF32(V+4) = in[k][1]; MRF32(V+8) = in[k][2];
        for (uint32_t a = SP - 0x40u; a < SP + 0x10u; a += 4) MR32(a) = 0x7F7F7F7Fu;  /* stale stack */
        c->esp = SP - 8u;                        /* the call: out pushed, then the return address */
        MR32(SP - 4u) = OUT; MR32(SP - 8u) = 0x00401000u;
        c->ecx = V;
        vnorm(c);
        double n = sqrt((double)in[k][0]*in[k][0] + (double)in[k][1]*in[k][1] + (double)in[k][2]*in[k][2]);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++){
            float want = (float)(in[k][i] / n), got = MRF32(OUT + 4u*(uint32_t)i);
            if (!(fabsf(got - want) <= 1e-6f)){
                printf("FAIL vector %u component %d: got %g (0x%08x), want %g\n", k, i, got, MR32(OUT + 4u*(uint32_t)i), want);
                fail++;
            }
        }
        if (c->eax != OUT || c->esp != SP || c->eip != 0x00401000u){ printf("FAIL vector %u: registers\n", k); fail++; }
    }
    printf("alias test: %s (%d failures)\n", fail ? "FAILED" : "passed", fail);
    return fail != 0;
}

{"id": "AT001350", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/tests/web/gilbench.c", "originalBytes": 3787, "originalSha256": "21f37822ab5db25f602713a090b685d85d9c0888bf34260b096cedfe6e7561bb", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 3787, "utf8TotalBytes": 3787}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/* The guest lock's hand-off in the browser (web/tools/gilbench.sh): the FIFO
 * ticket lock of runtime/web/ticketlock.h against wasi-libc's pthread mutex
 * (the old guest lock), with the threads as workers of the real host.
 *  1. ping-pong: 2..8 threads take the lock in turn, each holding it ~0 us;
 *     every acquisition is a hand-off: cost per hand-off, and the share of
 *     acquisitions each thread got (fairness).
 *  2. starvation: a "game" thread re-takes the lock right after releasing it
 *     (busy 2 ms per hold, like an uncapped game loop), a "feeder" sleeps
 *     10 ms and then needs the lock for 50 us (the DirectSound feeder); its
 *     wait for the lock is measured. */
#include "web/ticketlock.h"
#include "web/host_abi.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static ticketlock g_tl = TICKETLOCK_INIT;
static pthread_mutex_t g_mx = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static int g_use_mx;
static void lk(void){ if (g_use_mx) pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mx); else ticket_lock(&g_tl); }
static void ul(void){ if (g_use_mx) pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mx); else ticket_unlock(&g_tl); }
static double now(void){ return nfsu2_now_ms(); }
static void busy(double ms){ double t = now() + ms; while (now() < t) {} }

/* ---- 1. ping-pong ---- */
static volatile int g_stop; static long g_count[8]; static long g_total;
static void *pp(void *a){
    int i = (int)(long)a;
    while (!g_stop){ lk(); g_count[i]++; g_total++; ul(); }
    return 0;
}
static void pingpong(int nt){
    memset(g_count, 0, sizeof g_count); g_total = 0; g_stop = 0;
    pthread_t th[8];
    for (long i = 0; i < nt; i++) pthread_create(&th[i], 0, pp, (void *)i);
    double t0 = now(); usleep(1000000); g_stop = 1; double t1 = now();
    for (int i = 0; i < nt; i++) pthread_join(th[i], 0);
    long mn = g_count[0], mx = g_count[0], sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nt; i++){ if (g_count[i] < mn) mn = g_count[i]; if (g_count[i] > mx) mx = g_count[i]; sum += g_count[i]; }
    /* g_total is a plain counter bumped under the lock: equal to the sum
     * only if the lock really excluded */
    printf("  %-6s %d threads: %8ld acquisitions/s, %.2f us each; per thread min %ld max %ld (max/min %.1f)%s\n",
           g_use_mx ? "mutex" : "ticket", nt, (long)(g_total / ((t1 - t0) / 1000.0)), (t1 - t0) * 1000.0 / (double)g_total,
           mn, mx, mn ? (double)mx / (double)mn : 1e9, sum == g_total ? "" : "  EXCLUSION BROKEN");
}

/* ---- 2. starvation ---- */
static double g_w[4096]; static int g_nw;
static void *game(void *a){ (void)a; while (!g_stop){ lk(); busy(2.0); ul(); } return 0; }
static void *feeder(void *a){
    (void)a;
    while (!g_stop && g_nw < 4096){
        usleep(10000);
        double t0 = now(); lk(); g_w[g_nw++] = now() - t0; busy(0.05); ul();
    }
    return 0;
}
static int dcmp(const void *a, const void *b){ double x = *(const double *)a, y = *(const double *)b; return (x > y) - (x < y); }
static void starvation(void){
    g_stop = 0; g_nw = 0;
    pthread_t g, f;
    pthread_create(&g, 0, game, 0); pthread_create(&f, 0, feeder, 0);
    usleep(3000000); g_stop = 1;
    pthread_join(g, 0); pthread_join(f, 0);
    qsort(g_w, (size_t)g_nw, sizeof g_w[0], dcmp);
    printf("  %-6s feeder waits (%d): p50 %.3f  p90 %.3f  p99 %.3f  max %.3f ms\n", g_use_mx ? "mutex" : "ticket", g_nw,
           g_w[g_nw / 2], g_w[g_nw * 9 / 10], g_w[g_nw * 99 / 100], g_w[g_nw - 1]);
}

int main(void){
    printf("ping-pong (1 s each):\n");
    for (g_use_mx = 0; g_use_mx < 2; g_use_mx++) for (int nt = 2; nt <= 8; nt *= 2) pingpong(nt);
    printf("starvation (3 s each; game thread holds 2 ms and re-takes at once, feeder every 10 ms):\n");
    for (g_use_mx = 0; g_use_mx < 2; g_use_mx++) starvation();
    return 0;
}

{"id": "AT001351", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/tests/web/iostress.c", "originalBytes": 2095, "originalSha256": "83a83148a95d73c02bfc6b208a0dee234dc6e67c54484692e719b4f86e1e51c6", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 2095, "utf8TotalBytes": 2095}

/* Host I/O round trips under load (web/tools/iostress.sh): 8 threads each do
 * 20000 small preads at pseudo-random offsets of one /data file and compare
 * them with a copy read up front.  Every read is one RPC to the page's I/O
 * worker, answered within microseconds from its block cache, which is where
 * a waiter that misses the "done" notification hangs for good. */
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#define NT 8
#define N 20000
static const char *path = "/data/GLOBAL/GLOBALB.BUN";
static unsigned char *ref; static long size;
static int bad[NT];
static void *run(void *a){
    int t = (int)(long)a;
    int fd = open(path, O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0){ bad[t] = -1; return 0; }
    unsigned x = 12345u + (unsigned)t * 7919u;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++){
        x = x * 1103515245u + 12345u;
        long off = (long)(x % (unsigned)(size - 64));
        unsigned char b[64];
        if (pread(fd, b, 64, off) != 64 || memcmp(b, ref + off, 64)) bad[t]++;
    }
    close(fd);
    return 0;
}
int main(void){
    struct stat st; if (stat(path, &st)) { printf("FAIL stat\n"); return 1; }
    size = (long)st.st_size; if (size > (8 << 20)) size = 8 << 20;     /* the first 8 MB */
    ref = malloc((size_t)size);
    int fd = open(path, O_RDONLY); if (fd < 0 || pread(fd, ref, (size_t)size, 0) != size){ printf("FAIL read\n"); return 1; }
    close(fd);
    struct timespec t0, t1; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t0);
    pthread_t th[NT];
    for (long i = 0; i < NT; i++) pthread_create(&th[i], 0, run, (void *)i);
    for (int i = 0; i < NT; i++) pthread_join(th[i], 0);
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t1);
    double ms = (t1.tv_sec - t0.tv_sec) * 1e3 + (t1.tv_nsec - t0.tv_nsec) / 1e6;
    int errs = 0; for (int i = 0; i < NT; i++) errs += bad[i];
    printf("%s: %d threads x %d reads in %.0f ms (%.1f us per round trip), %d bad\n", errs ? "FAIL" : "OK",
           NT, N, ms, ms * 1000.0 / ((double)NT * N) * NT, errs);
    return errs ? 1 : 0;
}

/* runtime/web/tz.c under test (web/tools/tztest.sh): for each Unix time on
 * the command line prints localtime_r's fields and the mktime round trip, in
 * the zone NFSU2_TZ describes.  The JS side compares with the browser's own
 * local time (Date) for the same zone. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <time.h>
int main(int argc, char **argv){
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++){
        time_t t = (time_t)strtoll(argv[i], 0, 10);
        struct tm a; localtime_r(&t, &a);
        struct tm b = a; b.tm_isdst = -1; time_t back = mktime(&b);
        printf("%lld %ld %d %04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d %d %d %lld %s\n", (long long)t, (long)a.tm_gmtoff, a.tm_isdst,
               a.tm_year + 1900, a.tm_mon + 1, a.tm_mday, a.tm_hour, a.tm_min, a.tm_sec, a.tm_wday, a.tm_yday,
               (long long)back, tzname[a.tm_isdst > 0]);
    }
    return 0;
}

{"id": "AT001421", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/tests/web/x87pc.c", "originalBytes": 2377, "originalSha256": "dfaed42e5ef4f7feb82f5c3405a3f0c851aa78dcd294044c5c1a4f4d6c1473c4", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 2377, "utf8TotalBytes": 2377}

/* X87PC fast path check (web/tools/x87pctest.sh): x87_pcround, the inlined
 * PC=24 rounding every lifted x87 result goes through, against the exact
 * out-of-line x87_round24 for the game thread's control word (PC=24,
 * RC=nearest) and the CRT's (PC=53/64, returned as is).  Inputs: zeros,
 * subnormals, the float normal boundary and its neighbours, float max and
 * overflow, infinities, NaNs, random doubles over the whole exponent range and
 * random bit patterns.  Exit 0 = every result bit-identical. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

static uint64_t s = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
static uint64_t rnd(void){ s ^= s << 13; s ^= s >> 7; s ^= s << 17; return s; }
static double from(uint64_t b){ double d; memcpy(&d, &b, 8); return d; }
static uint64_t bits(double d){ uint64_t b; memcpy(&b, &d, 8); return b; }

int main(void){
    static const double fixed[] = { 0.0, -0.0, 0x1p-126, -0x1p-126, 0x1p-126 - 0x1p-150, 0x1p-126 - 0x1p-149, 0x1p-126 + 0x1p-150,
        0x1p-149, 0x1p-150, 0x1p-151, -0x1p-150, 0x1p-200, 0x1.fffffep127, 0x1.fffffefp127, 0x1.ffffffp127, 0x1p128, -0x1p128,
        1e300, 1.0 / 0.0, -1.0 / 0.0, 1.0 / 3.0, 0.1, 16777217.0, 4.9e-324 };
    long n = 0, bad = 0;
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++){
        uint16_t fcw = pass ? 0x027F : 0x007F;           /* PC=53: unchanged; PC=24: rounded */
        for (long i = 0; i < 4000000; i++){
            double v;
            if (i < (long)(sizeof fixed / sizeof *fixed)) v = fixed[i];
            else if (i < 2000000){                       /* random significand, exponent around the float range */
                uint64_t b = rnd(); int e = (int)(rnd() % 400) - 200 + 1023;
                v = from((b & 0x800FFFFFFFFFFFFFull) | ((uint64_t)e << 52));
                if ((i & 15) == 0) v = 0.0 * v;          /* signed zeros */
            } else v = from(rnd());                      /* any bit pattern: NaNs, infinities, huge, tiny */
            double want = pass ? v : x87_round24(v, 0);
            double got = x87_pcround(fcw, v);
            n++;
            if (bits(want) != bits(got) && !(want != want && got != got)){
                if (bad++ < 10) printf("  differs: fcw %04x v %a: want %a got %a\n", fcw, v, want, got);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("x87_pcround vs x87_round24: %ld inputs, %ld differ\n", n, bad);
    return bad != 0;
}

BEGIN TEXT OBJECT
{"id": "AT001422", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/tools/addoncar_seed.py", "originalBytes": 12710, "originalSha256": "5f4ab414d0c717857e21c2e7e71f8dbaac7eeb1c432c2fc7903eb1bc739086f1", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 12710, "utf8TotalBytes": 12710}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""A save tree for tests/scripts/career_addon_car.txt: a copy of a career seed (one car in slot 1) whose profile has
cars of car types the game does not have, as a modded game's profile can (runtime/garage.c addon_cars):

  tools/addoncar_seed.py <seed tree> <out tree> [--af28] [--name CLAUDE]

  - the career car (slot 1): car type bStringHash("ADDONCAR1")
  - Customize car 1: a copy of the career car's parts as car type "ADDONCAR2" (handle TUNED_CAR_0, as 0x52A710 makes one)
  - a GARAGE.DAT beside the profile (slots 6-10, runtime/garage.c): slot 6 a copy of the career car as "ADDONCAR3"
    (handle CAREER_SLOT_5, owned, open), slots 7-10 empty and locked, its fingerprint the poked profile's
  - --af28: the career car (before it is poked) with Art Factory 28 (ART_F_28) in its vinyl slot (0x40), as a profile
    saved before the vinyls were kept beside it: a raw key, for the conversion at the next save
  - --af28-only: only that (no car types poked, no GARAGE.DAT)
  - --badstock: stock car 1 of car type 60, past the game's 46 (a modded game's car lot sells its added cars):
    runtime/overrides.c cars_stock_fix makes the stock cars again as the profile loads
  - --newdir: a folder named MODPARTS.NEW beside the profile (a file of it), so the game cannot write that file
    (as on a full disk, where a new file fails and overwriting works)
  tools/addoncar_seed.py --compare <seed tree> <saved tree>
    which car records (Customize, slots 1-10, presets) a save made of the seed has byte for byte as the seed has them
  tools/addoncar_seed.py --two <seed tree> <out tree> [--full]
    slot 1 car type ADDA, slot 2 ADDB, each a copy of the career car with keys of its own in slots 0x60-0x6F, no
    GARAGE.DAT: two kept cars of the same stand-in and parts (Trade Car, tests/scripts/career_addon_trade.txt);
    --full: slots 3-5 locked and a GARAGE.DAT with 6-10 locked, so the car lot trades a car in for one it sells
  tools/addoncar_seed.py --check <saved tree> [--name CLAUDE]
    what a save made of it holds: the profile's checksums, the car types of slot 1, Customize car 1 and GARAGE.DAT's
    slot 6, slot 1's vinyl, and MODPARTS.DAT's entries (its head, kind 0 parts, entries of other kinds)
The profile is sealed again (web/src/app/profile.ts checksum).  The seed itself is never written: the tree is copied
first.  Prints the poked records' handles and car types.
"""
import shutil
import struct
import sys

PAYLOAD_AT = 36
CARS_PART = 39230
CUSTOM_AT, CUSTOM_SZ = 1156, 1072
CAREER_AT, CAREER_SZ = 22596, 2034
SLOT_VINYL = 0x40


def bhash(s):
    h = 0xFFFFFFFF
    for ch in s.encode():
        h = (h * 33 + ch) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return h


def crc_table():
    t = []
    for i in range(256):
        r = i << 24
        for _ in range(8):
            r = ((r << 1) ^ 0x04C11DB7) if r & 0x80000000 else (r << 1)
        t.append(r & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    return t


T = crc_table()


def checksum(d):
    if len(d) < 4:
        return 0
    r = ~((d[0] << 24) | (d[1] << 16) | (d[2] << 8) | d[3]) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    for b in d[4:]:
        r = (((r << 8) | b) ^ T[r >> 24]) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return ~r & 0xFFFFFFFF


def seal(f):
    struct.pack_into('<I', f, 16, checksum(f[28:36]))
    struct.pack_into('<I', f, 20, checksum(f[36:]))
    struct.pack_into('<I', f, 24, checksum(f[0:24]))


def fnv64(d):
    h = 0xcbf29ce484222325
    for b in d:
        h ^= b
        h = (h * 0x100000001b3) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    return h


NAMES = {bhash(n): n for n in ('PEUGOT', 'FOCUS', 'ADDONCAR1', 'ADDONCAR2', 'ADDONCAR3', 'ART_F_28', 'TUNED_CAR_0', 'ADDA', 'ADDB')}


def named(h):
    return f'{h:08x} ({NAMES[h]})' if h in NAMES else f'{h:08x}'


def check(tree, name):
    f = open(f'{tree}/NFS Underground 2/{name}/{name}', 'rb').read()
    sealed = struct.unpack_from('<3I', f, 16) == (checksum(f[28:36]), checksum(f[36:]), checksum(f[0:24]))
    pl = f[PAYLOAD_AT:]
    u = lambda o: struct.unpack_from('<I', pl, o)[0]
    print(f'profile: {len(f)} bytes, 20CM {f[:4] == b"20CM"}, checksums hold {sealed}, stock cars of a type past 46: '
          f'{sum(1 for i in range(48) if 46 <= u(i * 24 + 20) != 0xFFFFFFFF)}')
    print(f'slot 1: handle {u(CAREER_AT + 4):08x} car type {named(u(CAREER_AT + 28))}, vinyl {named(u(CAREER_AT + 32 + 4 * SLOT_VINYL))}')
    print('slots 1-5:', ', '.join(f'{named(u(CAREER_AT + i * CAREER_SZ + 28))} owned {pl[CAREER_AT + i * CAREER_SZ + 1073]} key60 '
                                  f'{u(CAREER_AT + i * CAREER_SZ + 32 + 4 * 0x60):08x}' for i in range(5)))
    print(f'Customize car 1: handle {named(u(CUSTOM_AT + 4))} car type {named(u(CUSTOM_AT + 28))}')
    try:
        g = open(f'{tree}/NFS Underground 2/{name}/GARAGE.DAT', 'rb').read()
        fp = fnv64(pl[:CARS_PART])
        hd = struct.unpack_from('<8I', g, 0)
        s6 = g[32:32 + CAREER_SZ]
        print(f'GARAGE.DAT: fingerprint matches {hd[2] == fp & 0xFFFFFFFF and hd[3] == fp >> 32}, slot 6 handle '
              f'{struct.unpack_from("<I", s6, 4)[0]:08x} car type {named(struct.unpack_from("<I", s6, 28)[0])} owned {s6[1073]}')
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print('GARAGE.DAT: none')
    try:
        m = open(f'{tree}/NFS Underground 2/{name}/MODPARTS.DAT', 'rb').read()
        hd = struct.unpack_from('<4I', m, 0)
        print(f'MODPARTS.DAT: magic {hd[0]:08x} version {hd[1]} count {hd[2]} (size {len(m)} = {16 + 32 * hd[2]}), write {hd[3]}')
        for i in range(hd[2]):
            w = struct.unpack_from('<8I', m, 16 + 32 * i)
            if w[7] == 0:
                print(f'  part: car {w[0]:08x} type {named(w[1])} slot {w[2]:#x} key {named(w[3])} stand-in {w[4]:08x}')
            elif w[7] == 1:
                ks = {}
                for j in range(hd[2]):
                    x = struct.unpack_from('<8I', m, 16 + 32 * j)
                    if x[7] == 2 and x[0] == w[0]:
                        for q in range(5): ks[x[1] + q] = x[2 + q]
                print(f'  car: {w[0]:08x} shown as {named(w[1])}, its own car type {named(w[3])}, {w[4]} key entries, '
                      f'key60 {ks.get(0x60, 0):08x} vinyl {named(ks.get(SLOT_VINYL, 0))}, fp {w[6]:08x}{w[5]:08x}')
            elif w[7] == 3 and w[0] == 0x4448504d:
                print(f'  head: the profile {w[1]:08x} (CLAUDE {bhash("CLAUDE"):08x}), write {w[2]}')
            elif w[7] != 2:
                print(f'  kind {w[7]}: {w}')
        print(f'  keys entries: {sum(1 for i in range(hd[2]) if struct.unpack_from("<I", m, 16 + 32 * i + 28)[0] == 2)}')
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print('MODPARTS.DAT: none')


def two(seed, out, full, name='CLAUDE'):
    shutil.copytree(seed, out)
    path = f'{out}/NFS Underground 2/{name}/{name}'
    f = bytearray(open(path, 'rb').read())
    rec = bytes(f[PAYLOAD_AT + CAREER_AT: PAYLOAD_AT + CAREER_AT + CAREER_SZ])
    for i, nm in enumerate(('ADDA', 'ADDB')):
        r = bytearray(rec)
        struct.pack_into('<I', r, 4, 0x319a8ca1 + i)
        struct.pack_into('<I', r, 28, bhash(nm))
        for s in range(0x60, 0x70):
            struct.pack_into('<I', r, 32 + 4 * s, 0xb0000000 | (i << 16) | s)
        r[1072], r[1073] = 0, 1
        f[PAYLOAD_AT + CAREER_AT + i * CAREER_SZ: PAYLOAD_AT + CAREER_AT + (i + 1) * CAREER_SZ] = r
    if full:
        for i in range(2, 5):
            f[PAYLOAD_AT + CAREER_AT + i * CAREER_SZ + 1072] = 1
    seal(f)
    open(path, 'wb').write(f)
    if full:
        pl = f[PAYLOAD_AT:]
        fp = fnv64(pl[:CARS_PART])
        empty = bytes(pl[CAREER_AT + 2 * CAREER_SZ: CAREER_AT + 3 * CAREER_SZ])
        slots = []
        for i in range(5):
            r = bytearray(empty)
            struct.pack_into('<I', r, 4, 0x319a8ca6 + i)
            r[1072], r[1073] = 1, 0
            slots.append(bytes(r))
        hd = struct.pack('<8I', 0x4147324e, 1, fp & 0xFFFFFFFF, fp >> 32, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        open(f'{out}/NFS Underground 2/{name}/GARAGE.DAT', 'wb').write(hd + b''.join(slots))
    print(f'slot 1 ADDA {bhash("ADDA"):08x}, slot 2 ADDB {bhash("ADDB"):08x}' + (' (2 of 10 slots open, both full)' if full else ''))


def records(tree, name='CLAUDE'):
    """every car record of the profile (Customize 20, slots 1-5, presets 6) and GARAGE.DAT's 5, by name: its bytes"""
    f = open(f'{tree}/NFS Underground 2/{name}/{name}', 'rb').read()[PAYLOAD_AT:]
    out = {}
    for i in range(20):
        out[f'Customize car {i + 1}'] = f[CUSTOM_AT + i * CUSTOM_SZ: CUSTOM_AT + (i + 1) * CUSTOM_SZ]
    for i in range(5):
        out[f'slot {i + 1}'] = f[CAREER_AT + i * CAREER_SZ: CAREER_AT + (i + 1) * CAREER_SZ]
    for i in range(6):
        out[f'preset {i + 1}'] = f[32770 + i * 1076: 32770 + (i + 1) * 1076]
    try:
        g = open(f'{tree}/NFS Underground 2/{name}/GARAGE.DAT', 'rb').read()
        for i in range(5):
            out[f'slot {6 + i}'] = g[32 + i * CAREER_SZ: 32 + (i + 1) * CAREER_SZ]
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass
    return out


def compare(seed, saved, name='CLAUDE'):
    a, b = records(seed, name), records(saved, name)
    same = [k for k in a if k in b and a[k] == b[k]]
    diff = [k for k in a if k in b and a[k] != b[k]]
    print(f'{len(same)} records byte for byte as in the seed; {len(diff)} not:')
    for k in diff:
        t0, t1 = struct.unpack_from('<I', a[k], 28)[0], struct.unpack_from('<I', b[k], 28)[0]
        print(f'  {k}: car type {named(t0)} -> {named(t1)}')


def main():
    if sys.argv[1:2] == ['--compare']:
        return compare(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
    if sys.argv[1:2] == ['--check']:
        nm = sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--name') + 1] if '--name' in sys.argv else 'CLAUDE'
        return check(sys.argv[2], nm)
    if sys.argv[1:2] == ['--two']:
        a = [x for x in sys.argv[2:] if not x.startswith('--')]
        return two(a[0], a[1], '--full' in sys.argv)
    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if not a.startswith('--')]
    flags = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a.startswith('--')]
    name = 'CLAUDE'
    for i, a in enumerate(sys.argv):
        if a == '--name':
            name = sys.argv[i + 1]
            args.remove(name)
    if len(args) != 2:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    seed, out = args
    shutil.copytree(seed, out)
    path = f'{out}/NFS Underground 2/{name}/{name}'
    f = bytearray(open(path, 'rb').read())
    assert f[:4] == b'20CM' and len(f) == 54966, 'not a profile of this version'

    def u32(o):
        return struct.unpack_from('<I', f, PAYLOAD_AT + o)[0]

    def put(o, v):
        struct.pack_into('<I', f, PAYLOAD_AT + o, v)

    car = CAREER_AT
    assert u32(car + 4) == 0x319a8ca1 and f[PAYLOAD_AT + car + 1073], 'slot 1 has no car'
    if '--af28' in flags or '--af28-only' in flags:
        put(car + 32 + 4 * SLOT_VINYL, bhash('ART_F_28'))
        print(f'slot 1: ART_F_28 {bhash("ART_F_28"):08x} in the vinyl slot')
    if '--af28-only' in flags:
        seal(f)
        open(path, 'wb').write(f)
        return
    rec = bytes(f[PAYLOAD_AT + car: PAYLOAD_AT + car + CAREER_SZ])
    # Customize car 1: 5 words (+4 0, handle, +0xC 0, in use, kind 2), the parts block (0x418), +0x430
    cu = CUSTOM_AT
    f[PAYLOAD_AT + cu: PAYLOAD_AT + cu + CUSTOM_SZ] = struct.pack('<5I', 0, bhash('TUNED_CAR_0'), 0, 1, 2) + rec[20:20 + 0x418] + rec[1068:1072]
    put(cu + 28, bhash('ADDONCAR2'))
    put(car + 28, bhash('ADDONCAR1'))
    if '--badstock' in flags:
        put(20, 60)
        print('stock car 1: car type 60')
    seal(f)
    open(path, 'wb').write(f)
    pl = f[PAYLOAD_AT:]
    fp = fnv64(pl[:CARS_PART])
    # GARAGE.DAT: slot 6 the career car as ADDONCAR3, slots 7-10 as slot 2 (empty), locked
    empty = bytes(pl[CAREER_AT + CAREER_SZ: CAREER_AT + 2 * CAREER_SZ])
    slots = []
    for i in range(5):
        r = bytearray(rec if i == 0 else empty)
        struct.pack_into('<I', r, 4, 0x319a8ca6 + i)

"""Infer each import's stdcall argument count from the push sequences at its call sites.
   Also count fs:/gs: segment use (SEH/TLS)."""
import sys, struct, collections

import pefile

# (pefile refuses the relocated analysis copy's import directory) and move
# the IAT addresses to this image's base.

    for nm,va,vs,d in L.secs:
        if va<=a<va+len(d)-3: return struct.unpack_from('<I',d,a-va)[0]

    va=q.popleft(); recent=[]
    while True:
        if not L.in_text(va): break
        off=va-L.TVA
        if off>=L.TSZ or cov[off]: break
        try: i=next(md.disasm(L.TDATA[off:off+16],va))
        except StopIteration: break
        for k in range(i.size):
            if off+k<L.TSZ: cov[off+k]=1
        m=i.mnemonic; ops=i.operands; o=ops[0] if ops else None

            t=o.mem.disp & 0xffffffff
            if t in iat:
                n=0; hit_prologue=False
                prev_was_mov_ebp_esp=False
                for prev in reversed(recent):

                        hit_prologue=True; break
                    if m2=='sub' and ops2.startswith('esp'):

                        continue
                    else: break

                    argv.setdefault(t, collections.Counter())

        if m=='call':

        if m=='jmp':

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Checks NFSU2FreeRoam.asi as a file, without Windows (pefile, capstone).

  tools/asi_check.py out/win/NFSU2FreeRoam.asi [SPEED2.EXE]

  1. PE: 32-bit x86 DLL, GUI subsystem, DYNAMIC_BASE + NX_COMPAT, relocations,
     no TLS, no section both writable and executable, under 256 KB.
  2. Exports exactly InitializeASI; the entry point is DllMain.
  3. Imports only KERNEL32 and WS2_32, and only the functions listed here
     (no C runtime, no libgcc/winpthread DLL, nothing a friend's PC lacks:
     every one exists since Windows XP).
  4. The frame hook site in SPEED2.EXE (0x581475) holds the call the plugin
     expects (E8 46 0E E8 FF = call 0x4022C0, and 0x4022C0 is a ret), and
     neither it nor 16 bytes around it are patched by ExtraOptions, Unlimiter
     or WidescreenFix (win/roam_asi/modsites.txt); the plugin's code
     fingerprint (win/roam_asi/roam_fp.h) matches the exe and avoids every
     mod patch site.
  5. The thunks (capstone): the frame thunk saves and restores every
     register and the flags, realigns the stack, keeps the thread's SEH chain
     head (FS:[0]) and ends in an indirect jump through the chain pointer;
     the fault guard's way back puts FS:[0] back before anything else runs;
     the call thunk restores esp from ebp.
Exit status 0 when everything passes.
"""

from capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32

        'DisableThreadLibraryCalls', 'EnterCriticalSection', 'FlushInstructionCache', 'GetCurrentProcess',
        'GetCurrentProcessId', 'GetCurrentThreadId', 'GetEnvironmentVariableA', 'GetLastError', 'GetLocalTime',
        'GetModuleFileNameA', 'GetModuleHandleA', 'GetPrivateProfileStringA', 'GetTickCount',
        'InitializeCriticalSection', 'InterlockedCompareExchange', 'LeaveCriticalSection', 'QueryPerformanceCounter',
        'QueryPerformanceFrequency', 'Sleep', 'TryEnterCriticalSection', 'VirtualProtect', 'VirtualQuery',
        'WaitForSingleObject', 'WriteFile', 'lstrcmpA', 'lstrcmpiA', 'lstrcpyA', 'lstrlenA'},
    'WS2_32.dll': {
        'WSACleanup', 'WSAGetLastError', 'WSAIoctl', 'WSAStartup', '__WSAFDIsSet', 'bind', 'closesocket',
        'ioctlsocket', 'recvfrom', 'select', 'sendto', 'setsockopt', 'socket'},
}
HOOK_SITE = 0x581475
fails = []


def check(cond, msg):
    print(('  ok    ' if cond else '  FAIL  ') + msg)
    if not cond:
        fails.append(msg)


def main():
    asi = sys.argv[1]
    exe = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else os.path.join(ROOT, '..', '..', 'gamedata', 'SPEED2.EXE')
    data = open(asi, 'rb').read()
    pe = pefile.PE(data=data)
    print('%s: %d bytes' % (asi, len(data)))
    print('1. PE structure')
    check(pe.FILE_HEADER.Machine == 0x14C, 'machine i386 (0x14c)')
    check(pe.FILE_HEADER.Characteristics & 0x2000 != 0, 'a DLL')
    check(pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.Magic == 0x10B, 'PE32 (32-bit)')
    check(pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.Subsystem == 2, 'GUI subsystem')
    dc = pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.DllCharacteristics
    check(dc & 0x40 and dc & 0x100, 'DYNAMIC_BASE and NX_COMPAT (0x%x)' % dc)
    relocs = sum(len(b.entries) for b in getattr(pe, 'DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC', []))
    check(relocs > 0, 'base relocations present (%d): loads at any address' % relocs)
    tls = pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.DATA_DIRECTORY[9]
    check(tls.VirtualAddress == 0 and tls.Size == 0, 'no TLS directory (nothing runs before DllMain)')
    wx = [s.Name.rstrip(b'\0').decode() for s in pe.sections if s.Characteristics & 0x80000000 and s.Characteristics & 0x20000000]
    check(not wx, 'no section both writable and executable%s' % (' (' + ', '.join(wx) + ')' if wx else ''))
    check(len(data) < 256 * 1024, 'under 256 KB')
    check(pe.FILE_HEADER.TimeDateStamp == 0, 'no time stamp (reproducible build)')
    dbg = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(asi), 'dbg', os.path.basename(asi))
    if os.path.exists(dbg) and dbg != asi:
        dp = pefile.PE(dbg)
        same = [(x.Name, x.get_data()) for x in pe.sections] == [(x.Name, x.get_data()) for x in dp.sections[:len(pe.sections)]] and \
            pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.AddressOfEntryPoint == dp.OPTIONAL_HEADER.AddressOfEntryPoint
        check(same, 'the same sections and entry point as dbg/%s, the copy with symbols the tests run' % os.path.basename(dbg))
    print('2. Exports and entry point')
    exps = [e.name.decode() for e in pe.DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT.symbols] if hasattr(pe, 'DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT') else []
    check(exps == ['InitializeASI'], 'exports exactly InitializeASI (%s)' % ', '.join(exps))
    mp = open(asi.replace('.asi', '.map')).read() if os.path.exists(asi.replace('.asi', '.map')) else ''
    m = re.search(r'0x([0-9a-f]+)\s+_?DllMain@12', mp)
    check(m is not None and int(m.group(1), 16) == pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase + pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.AddressOfEntryPoint,
          'the entry point is DllMain (%s)' % ('0x%x' % int(m.group(1), 16) if m else 'no linker map'))
    print('3. Imports')
    dlls = {}
    for d in pe.DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT:
        dlls[d.dll.decode()] = sorted(i.name.decode() for i in d.imports)
    check(set(dlls) <= set(ALLOWED), 'DLLs: %s' % ', '.join(dlls))
    for d, fns in dlls.items():
        extra = [f for f in fns if f not in ALLOWED.get(d, ())]
        check(not extra, '%s: %d functions, all in the allowed list%s' % (d, len(fns), (' -- NOT: ' + ', '.join(extra)) if extra else ''))
        print('        ' + ' '.join(fns))
    print('4. SPEED2.EXE: hook site, fingerprint, other mods')
    ex = pefile.PE(exe, fast_load=True)
    img = ex.get_memory_mapped_image()
    b = lambda va, n: img[va - 0x400000: va - 0x400000 + n]
    check(b(HOOK_SITE, 5) == bytes.fromhex('e8460ee8ff'), '0x581475: E8 46 0E E8 FF (call 0x4022C0)')
    check(b(0x4022C0, 1) == b'\xc3', '0x4022C0: ret (the empty debug function)')
    check(ex.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase + ex.OPTIONAL_HEADER.AddressOfEntryPoint == 0x75BCC7, 'entry point 0x75BCC7 (v1.2 NA)')
    sites = []
    for l in open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'win', 'roam_asi', 'modsites.txt')):
        if l.startswith('0x'):
            p = l.split()
            sites.append((int(p[0], 16), int(p[0], 16) + int(p[1]), p[2], ' '.join(p[3:])))
    near = [s for s in sites if s[0] < HOOK_SITE + 5 + 16 and s[1] > HOOK_SITE - 16]
    over = [s for s in sites if s[0] < HOOK_SITE + 5 and s[1] > HOOK_SITE]
    check(not over, 'no mod patches 0x581475..0x581479 (%d mod sites known)' % len(sites))
    print('        within 16 bytes: ' + ('; '.join('%s %s at 0x%x..0x%x' % (s[2], s[3], s[0], s[1] - 1) for s in near) or 'none'))
    fp = open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'win', 'roam_asi', 'roam_fp.h')).read()
    ents = re.findall(r'\{ 0x([0-9A-F]+)u,\s*(\d+), (RF_\w+)\s*, 0x([0-9A-F]+)u, "([^"]*)" \}', fp)
    bad = [e for e in ents if zlib.crc32(b(int(e[0], 16), int(e[1]))) != int(e[3], 16)]
    check(ents and not bad, 'fingerprint: %d windows, all match the exe' % len(ents))
    clash = []
    for va, n, kind, crc, what in ents:
        lo, hi = int(va, 16), int(va, 16) + int(n)
        for s in sites:
            if s[0] < hi and s[1] > lo and not (kind == 'RF_FN' and s[0] == lo):
                clash.append('%s at 0x%x: %s %s' % (what, lo, s[2], s[3]))
    check(not clash, 'fingerprint windows avoid every mod patch site (except whole-function replacements at the entry)' +
          ('' if not clash else ': ' + '; '.join(clash)))
    print('5. Thunks')
    dbgpe = pefile.PE(dbg) if os.path.exists(dbg) else None

    def sym(name):
        m = re.search(r'0x([0-9a-f]+)\s+_?%s\b' % re.escape(name.lstrip('_')), mp)
        return int(m.group(1), 16) if m else None
    md = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)
    ft, ct, chain = sym('_roam_frame_thunk'), sym('_roam_call_asm'), sym('_g_roam_chain')
    if dbgpe and ft and ct:
        dimg = dbgpe.get_memory_mapped_image()
        base = dbgpe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase
        code = lambda va, n: dimg[va - base: va - base + n]
        ins = list(md.disasm(code(ft, 64), ft))
        txt = ['%s %s' % (i.mnemonic, i.op_str) for i in ins]
        print('        frame thunk: ' + ' | '.join(txt[:12]))
        check(txt[:2] == ['pushal ', 'pushfd '] or (txt[0].startswith('pushal') and txt[1].startswith('pushf')), 'frame thunk starts with pushal; pushfd')
        k = next((i for i, t in enumerate(txt) if t.startswith('jmp dword ptr')), None)
        check(k is not None and txt[k - 1].startswith('popal') and txt[k - 2].startswith('popf') and
              ('0x%x' % chain) in txt[k], 'frame thunk ends popfd; popal; jmp [g_roam_chain]')
        check(any(t.startswith('and esp, 0xfffffff0') for t in txt), 'frame thunk aligns the stack to 16 bytes')
        check(any(t == 'cld ' or t.startswith('cld') for t in txt), 'frame thunk clears the direction flag')
        seh = sym('_g_roam_resume_seh')
        k0 = next((i for i, t in enumerate(txt) if t.startswith('mov eax, dword ptr fs:[0]')), None)
        check(seh is not None and k0 is not None and k0 + 1 < len(txt) and txt[k0 + 1].startswith('mov dword ptr [0x%x], eax' % seh),
              'frame thunk keeps FS:[0] (the SEH chain head) in g_roam_resume_seh')
        fr = sym('_roam_fault_resume')
        if fr:
            rt = ['%s %s' % (i.mnemonic, i.op_str) for i in md.disasm(code(fr, 32), fr)]
            print('        fault resume: ' + ' | '.join(rt[:6]))
            kc = next((i for i, t in enumerate(rt) if t.startswith('call')), None)
            check(seh is not None and kc is not None and any(t.startswith('mov eax, dword ptr [0x%x]' % seh) for t in rt[:kc]) and
                  any(t.startswith('mov dword ptr fs:[0], eax') for t in rt[:kc]),
                  'the fault guard puts FS:[0] back before it calls into the plugin')
        else:
            check(False, 'symbol roam_fault_resume')
        ins = list(md.disasm(code(ct, 64), ct))
        txt = ['%s %s' % (i.mnemonic, i.op_str) for i in ins]
        print('        call thunk: ' + ' | '.join(txt[:20]))
        r = next((i for i, t in enumerate(txt) if t.startswith('ret')), None)
        check(r is not None and txt[r - 5].startswith('lea esp, [ebp - 0xc]'), 'call thunk restores esp from ebp after the call')
        check(any(t.startswith('call dword ptr [ebp + 8]') for t in txt), 'call thunk calls the function pointer argument')
    else:
        check(False, 'symbols of the thunks (NFSU2FreeRoam.dbg.asi, .map)')
    print('%s: %s' % (os.path.basename(asi), 'PASS' if not fails else 'FAIL (%d)' % len(fails)))
    return 1 if fails else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

#!/bin/bash
# Automated test run (no env scrubbing, unlike run.sh).
#   tools/autorun.sh <outdir> [VAR=value ...]
# Runs out/nfsu2_boot windowed (background window, no focus steal) against
# $NFSU2_DATA (default: ../../work/gamedata), with run.sh's required
# defaults (FIXMAT, NOMOVIES, SNDSYNC, GPUVS).  Everything goes to <outdir>:
# log.txt (stdout+stderr), frame dumps, registry file (copied from
# $NFSU2_REGFILE_SEED if given).  Extra VAR=value args are exported first,
# so they count like the environment for everything below (the defaults,
# NFSU2_SAVE_SEED, NFSU2_REGFILE_SEED, NFSU2_SAVEDIR, NFSU2_BIN ...).
# Network: off unless the test selects NFSU2_NET=loopback or vlan:<hub>, or
# NFSU2_ROAM=1; a test run can never use the real network (NFSU2_NET_HARNESS=1
# makes the Winsock HLE refuse it, NFSU2_ROAM_HARNESS=1 keeps free roam on
# loopback), and a run with any network mode is wrapped in the loopback-only
# sandbox profile tests/net/loopback-only.sb (NFSU2_SANDBOX=0 skips the
# wrapper; a caller already inside it sets NFSU2_SANDBOXED=1).
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
OUT="${1:?usage: tools/autorun.sh <outdir> [VAR=value ...]}"; shift
for kv in "$@"; do export "$kv"; done
mkdir -p "$OUT"; OUT="$(cd "$OUT" && pwd)"
DATA="${NFSU2_DATA:-$ROOT/../../work/gamedata}"
export FIXMAT="${FIXMAT:-0}" FIXMAT_MODE="${FIXMAT_MODE:-3}" NOMOVIES="${NOMOVIES:-1}"   # FIXMAT: see run.sh
export SNDSYNC="${SNDSYNC:-1}" GPUVS="${GPUVS:-1}"
export WINDOW="${WINDOW-1}" NOFOCUS="${NOFOCUS-1}" ALARM="${ALARM:-120}"
# Discord presence is OFF in test runs: the real Discord app may be running on
# this Mac and must never see a test.  A test that wants it sets
# NFSU2_DISCORD=1 together with NFSU2_DISCORD_IPC=<mock socket>
# (tools/mock_discord.py); without the override path it stays off.
export NFSU2_DISCORD="${NFSU2_DISCORD:-0}"
# Test runs are silent (the mixer still runs, see audio.m); NFSU2_MUTE=0 to listen.
export NFSU2_MUTE="${NFSU2_MUTE:-1}"
# windowed, whatever the player last chose with Cmd-F (tools/apptest.sh)
export NFSFULL="${NFSFULL:-0}"
export DUMPDIR="${DUMPDIR:-$OUT}" NFSU2_DUMP_DIR="${NFSU2_DUMP_DIR:-$OUT}"
export NFSU2_REGFILE="${NFSU2_REGFILE:-$OUT/registry.txt}"
# Application Support (texture packs, the texture dump: texrep.m) is the
# run's own, never the player's ~/Library/Application Support/NFSU2; a test
# that wants a pack passes NFSU2_APPSUPPORT=<dir with Textures/> or NFSU2_TEXPACK.
export NFSU2_APPSUPPORT="${NFSU2_APPSUPPORT:-$OUT/support}"
# Saves/profiles go to a per-run overlay (reads fall back to the data dir).
# NFSU2_SAVE_SEED=<dir>: copy an existing save tree in first.
export NFSU2_SAVEDIR="${NFSU2_SAVEDIR:-$OUT/save}"
mkdir -p "$NFSU2_SAVEDIR"
[ -n "$NFSU2_SAVE_SEED" ] && cp -R "$NFSU2_SAVE_SEED"/. "$NFSU2_SAVEDIR"/
[ -n "$NFSU2_REGFILE_SEED" ] && [ ! -f "$NFSU2_REGFILE" ] && cp "$NFSU2_REGFILE_SEED" "$NFSU2_REGFILE"
if [ "$NFSU2_DISCORD" != 0 ] && [ -z "$NFSU2_DISCORD_IPC" ]; then
  echo "autorun: NFSU2_DISCORD on without NFSU2_DISCORD_IPC (a mock socket); forcing it off" >&2
  export NFSU2_DISCORD=0
fi
# Network: LAN play (winsock.c) and free-roam multiplayer (roam_bsd.c).  A
# test run is always the harness for both: LAN off unless the test selects
# loopback or the virtual LAN, never the real LAN; free roam on loopback only,
# no LAN discovery.  Any networked run is inside the one loopback-only
# sandbox profile (IP beyond 127.0.0.1 refused by the kernel; AF_UNIX, the
# vlan hub, allowed).
export NFSU2_NET="${NFSU2_NET:-off}"
export NFSU2_NET_HARNESS=1 NFSU2_ROAM_HARNESS=1
SBX=()
if { [ "$NFSU2_NET" != off ] || [ "${NFSU2_ROAM:-0}" != 0 ]; } && [ "${NFSU2_SANDBOX:-1}" != 0 ] \
   && [ "${NFSU2_SANDBOXED:-0}" != 1 ] && [ -x /usr/bin/sandbox-exec ]; then
  SBX=(/usr/bin/sandbox-exec -f "$ROOT/tests/net/loopback-only.sb")
fi
# SIP drops DYLD_* variables when sandbox-exec (a system binary) starts, so
# an interposer such as tools/writewatch.c (DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=... as a
# VAR=value argument) reaches the game through env, inside the sandbox
[ ${#SBX[@]} -gt 0 ] && [ -n "${DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES:-}" ] && SBX+=(/usr/bin/env "DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=$DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES")
cd "$OUT"
start=$(date +%s)
"${SBX[@]}" "$ROOT/out/${NFSU2_BIN:-nfsu2_boot}" "$DATA/SPEED2.EXE" > "$OUT/log.txt" 2>&1
rc=$?
echo "exit=$rc wall=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))s log=$OUT/log.txt"
exit $rc

{"id": "AT001427", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/tools/bcmp.py", "originalBytes": 1496, "originalSha256": "e3dd10dd62167766a5541a4465fb46805e9b214814ff7b344a84b6ca00130f69", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 1496, "utf8TotalBytes": 1496}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Match two FPSCSV runs by real-time buckets and compare them.

On the real clock the game state follows the real time elapsed: same second =
same scene.  Frames go into 0.5 s buckets (cumulative ms), the median is taken
per bucket, the two runs are matched bucket by bucket.  Race frames only
(draws, the draw count, > 400).

    tools/bcmp.py a1.csv,a2.csv b1.csv,b2.csv     (groups A and B, comma-separated)
"""
import csv, sys, statistics as st

def buckets(path, w=0.5):
    t = 0.0; b = {}
    with open(path) as f:
        for r in csv.DictReader(f):
            ms = float(r['ms']); t += ms / 1000.0
            if int(r['draws']) <= 400 or ms > 100: continue   # menu / dump frame
            b.setdefault(int(t / w), []).append(ms)
    return {k: st.median(v) for k, v in b.items() if len(v) >= 3}

def group(paths):
    bs = [buckets(p) for p in paths]
    keys = set.intersection(*[set(x) for x in bs])
    return {k: st.median([x[k] for x in bs]) for k in keys}

a = group(sys.argv[1].split(',')); b = group(sys.argv[2].split(','))
keys = sorted(set(a) & set(b))
if not keys: sys.exit("no race bucket in common")
ratios = [b[k] / a[k] for k in keys]
ma = st.median([a[k] for k in keys]); mb = st.median([b[k] for k in keys])
print(f"matched buckets: {len(keys)}")
print(f"A median {ma:.2f} ms ({1000/ma:.1f} fps)   B median {mb:.2f} ms ({1000/mb:.1f} fps)")
print(f"B/A matched ratio (median): {st.median(ratios):.4f}  ->  {100*(st.median(ratios)-1):+.1f}%")
