// tools/brand/make.mjs bundles this into a page Chrome draws: every logo and icon file, as PNG data URLs, in the
// lettering of the mark on F12 pictures (web/src/gpu/mark.ts).
import { drawMark, markBox, markFont } from '../../web/src/gpu/mark';

const WHITE = '#ffffff', GREEN = '#b8de7d', BG = '#0d0d0d', FRAME = '#171717';
type G = CanvasRenderingContext2D;
type Part = [string, string];

function canvas(w: number, h: number): [HTMLCanvasElement, G] {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h;
  return [c, c.getContext('2d')!];
}
function ink(g: G, text: string, px: number) {
  g.font = markFont(px);
  const m = g.measureText(text);
  return { l: m.actualBoundingBoxLeft, r: m.actualBoundingBoxRight, a: m.actualBoundingBoxAscent, d: m.actualBoundingBoxDescent };
}
function parts(g: G, ps: Part[], px: number, x: number, y: number) {
  g.font = markFont(px);
  for (const [t, c] of ps) { g.fillStyle = c; g.fillText(t, x, y); x += g.measureText(t).width; }
}
/** ps on one line, its ink w wide, its ink's middle at (cx, cy) */
function fit(g: G, ps: Part[], w: number, cx: number, cy: number) {
  const s = ps.map(p => p[0]).join(''), b0 = ink(g, s, 100), px = 100 * w / (b0.l + b0.r), b = ink(g, s, px);
  parts(g, ps, px, cx - (b.r - b.l) / 2, cy + (b.a - b.d) / 2);
}
/** "nfsu2" over ".xyz", their ink's left edges lined up, "nfsu2"'s ink w wide, the pair's ink in the middle at (cx, cy) */
function stacked(g: G, w: number, cx: number, cy: number) {
  const b0 = ink(g, 'nfsu2', 100), px = 100 * w / (b0.l + b0.r), a = ink(g, 'nfsu2', px), b = ink(g, '.xyz', px);
  const gap = px * 0.14, h = a.a + gap + b.a + b.d, y1 = cy - h / 2 + a.a, x0 = cx - (a.r + a.l) / 2 + a.l;
  parts(g, [['nfsu2', WHITE]], px, x0, y1);
  parts(g, [['.xyz', GREEN]], px, x0 - a.l + b.l, y1 + gap + b.a);
}
/** the start page's background: --bg with its soft light at the top (style.css body) */
function pageBg(g: G, w: number, h: number) {
  g.fillStyle = BG; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  const s = w / 1280;
  g.save(); g.translate(w / 2, -160 * s); g.scale(1, 480 / 1200); g.translate(-w / 2, 160 * s);
  const r = g.createRadialGradient(w / 2, -160 * s, 0, w / 2, -160 * s, 1200 * s * 0.7);
  r.addColorStop(0, '#2a2a2a'); r.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(42,42,42,0)');
  g.fillStyle = r; g.fillRect(0, -2000, w, 6000); g.restore();
}
function rounded(g: G, n: number, colour: string) {
  g.beginPath(); g.roundRect(0, 0, n, n, n / 4); g.fillStyle = colour; g.fill();
}
/** the canvas cut to what is drawn on it (alpha > 0), a pixel round it */
function trim(c: HTMLCanvasElement): HTMLCanvasElement {
  const d = c.getContext('2d')!.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data;
  let x0 = c.width, y0 = c.height, x1 = -1, y1 = -1;
  for (let y = 0; y < c.height; y++) for (let x = 0; x < c.width; x++)
    if (d[(y * c.width + x) * 4 + 3]) { if (x < x0) x0 = x; if (x > x1) x1 = x; if (y < y0) y0 = y; if (y > y1) y1 = y; }
  const [o, g] = canvas(x1 - x0 + 3, y1 - y0 + 3);
  g.drawImage(c, x0 - 1, y0 - 1, o.width, o.height, 0, 0, o.width, o.height);
  return o;
}
/** the logo: the mark at size px on a clear background, with its shadow (or in other colours, without) */
function logo(px: number, dark?: [string, string]) {
  const [c, g] = canvas(px * 6, px * 3);
  if (dark) parts(g, [['nfsu2', dark[0]], ['.xyz', dark[1]]], px, px, px * 1.5);
  else drawMark(g, px, px, px * 1.5);
  return trim(c);
}

export function brand(): [string, string][] {
  const out: [string, string][] = [];
  const put = (name: string, c: HTMLCanvasElement) => out.push([name, c.toDataURL('image/png')]);

  put('tools/brand/logo.png', logo(400));
  put('tools/brand/logo-dark.png', logo(400, [FRAME, '#5f8a1e']));
  { const [c, g] = canvas(1024, 1024); g.fillStyle = BG; g.fillRect(0, 0, 1024, 1024); stacked(g, 640, 512, 512); put('tools/brand/discord-icon.png', c); }
  // Discord's channel list shows only a band of the banner across its middle, about 2.4:1 (the rest is cut): the mark
  // goes in that band's bottom right, as on a screenshot, with room for a band down to 2.6:1 (y 171..909)
  { const [c, g] = canvas(1920, 1080); pageBg(g, 1920, 1080);

#!/bin/bash
# Builds the Windows companion of the free-roam multiplayer: NFSU2FreeRoam.asi
# (Ultimate ASI Loader plugin for the original PC game, SPEED2.EXE v1.2 NA).
#   tools/build_roam_asi.sh            -> out/win/
# Needs the mingw-w64 cross compiler (Homebrew: brew install mingw-w64).
#
# The protocol core and the game side are the Mac port's own sources
# (runtime/roam_core.c, runtime/roam_game.c), built for 32-bit x86 with the
# flags that make their floats bit-identical to the arm64 build: SSE2 math,
# no fused multiply-add.  Freestanding: no C runtime, no libgcc DLL, no
# pthreads; the plugin imports KERNEL32 and WS2_32 only (tools/asi_check.py
# verifies that).  Reproducible: no time stamp, the same bytes every build.
#
# Output (out/win/):
#   NFSU2FreeRoam.asi        the plugin (stripped)
#   dbg/NFSU2FreeRoam.asi    the same with symbols (the Unicorn tests use it)
#   NFSU2FreeRoam.map        linker map
#   roam_selftest.dll        tests/roam_selftest.c on the plugin's own core
#                            object (tools/roam_x86check.sh runs it)
#   dist/                    what a Windows friend copies into the game folder
#                            (scripts/NFSU2FreeRoam.asi + .ini, README.txt)
set -e
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"; cd "$ROOT"
CC="${MINGW_CC:-i686-w64-mingw32-gcc}"
command -v "$CC" >/dev/null || { echo "build_roam_asi: $CC not found (brew install mingw-w64)"; exit 1; }
O=out/win; mkdir -p "$O/obj" "$O/dbg" "$O/dist/scripts"
VER="${ROAM_ASI_VERSION:-1.0}"
# -msse2 -mfpmath=sse: float math in SSE (IEEE single/double, as on arm64),
#   never the x87 (whose precision the game's D3D device sets to 24 bits);
# -ffp-contract=off: no fused multiply-add (arm64 would fuse otherwise);
# -mstackrealign: the game and Windows call us with 4-byte aligned stacks;
# -fno-strict-aliasing: guest memory is read through casts;
# -ffreestanding, no stack protector, no unwind tables: no C runtime at all.
CFLAGS="-std=c11 -O2 -march=i686 -msse2 -mfpmath=sse -mstackrealign -ffp-contract=off -fno-strict-aliasing \
 -ffreestanding -fno-stack-protector -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables -fno-ident -fno-pic \
 -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -DROAM_HOST_WIN -DROAM_ASI_VERSION=\"$VER\" -Iwin/roam_asi -Iruntime"
LDFLAGS="-shared -nostdlib -Wl,--subsystem,windows:5.1 -Wl,--no-insert-timestamp -Wl,--dynamicbase -Wl,--nxcompat -Wl,--image-base,0x10000000 \
 -Wl,--enable-reloc-section -Wl,--disable-auto-import -Wl,--major-os-version,5 -Wl,--minor-os-version,1 \
 -Wl,--major-subsystem-version,5 -Wl,--minor-subsystem-version,1"
LIBS="-lkernel32 -lws2_32 -lgcc"
# the exe check's table, from the game's exe when it is here (it is

EXE="${NFSU2_DATA:-$ROOT/../../gamedata}/SPEED2.EXE"

  "$ROOT/.venv/bin/python" -I tools/roam_fingerprint.py "$EXE" > "$O/roam_fp.h.new" 2>/dev/null
  cmp -s "$O/roam_fp.h.new" win/roam_asi/roam_fp.h || { echo "build_roam_asi: win/roam_asi/roam_fp.h is out of date (tools/roam_fingerprint.py)"; exit 1; }
  rm -f "$O/roam_fp.h.new"
fi
$CC $CFLAGS -c -o "$O/obj/roam_core.o" runtime/roam_core.c
$CC $CFLAGS -c -o "$O/obj/roam_game.o" runtime/roam_game.c
$CC $CFLAGS -c -o "$O/obj/roam_win.o"  win/roam_asi/roam_win.c
$CC $CFLAGS -c -o "$O/obj/roam_asi.o"  win/roam_asi/roam_asi.c
$CC $CFLAGS -fno-builtin -fno-tree-loop-distribute-patterns -c -o "$O/obj/roam_libc.o" win/roam_asi/roam_libc.c

# stamp the time into the header; tools/asi_check.py compares the sections)
$CC $LDFLAGS -e _DllMain@12 -s -o "$O/NFSU2FreeRoam.asi" $OBJS $LIBS
# the core's cross-platform self-test on the plugin's own objects
$CC $CFLAGS -DROAM_SELFTEST_EXTERN_CORE -c -o "$O/obj/roam_selftest.o" tests/roam_selftest.c

{"id": "AT001431", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/tools/career_report.py", "originalBytes": 5085, "originalSha256": "466722a37dc6a75afdff31be22450be943bae93fd57156cf371bcc7ba34b4232", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 5085, "utf8TotalBytes": 5085}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Summarise career-bot segment runs (tools/career_segments.sh output); TEST-ONLY tooling.

    tools/career_report.py <rundir> [<rundir> ...]

For every segment (segNN/log.txt): races won (name, type, stage), stage and
bank at the end, cover shoots, fps (min/median of the [status] lines), guest
heap and max RSS at the end, and the first-occurrence diagnostics ([trap],
[hle] UNIMPLEMENTED, unresolved indirect calls, faults, timeouts).  Prints a
Markdown table plus a per-stage x event-type count of races won.
"""
import re, sys, glob, os, statistics, collections

TYPES = {"CIRCUIT": "circuit", "SPRINT": "sprint", "STREET": "streetx", "SHORT": "streetx", "DRAG": "drag",
         "DRIFT": "drift", "URL": "url", "SUV": "suv"}

def race_kind(name):
    # S2_SPON_DRAG_1 -> (2, "sponsor drag"); STAGE_1_DRIFT_1 -> (1, "drift")
    m = re.match(r"(?:S|STAGE_)(\d)_(.*)", name)
    if not m:
        return None, name
    st, rest = int(m.group(1)), m.group(2).split("_")
    spon = "SPON" in rest
    t = next((TYPES[p] for p in rest if p in TYPES), "?")
    return st, ("sponsor " if spon else "") + t

def seg_report(log):
    txt = open(log, "r", errors="replace").read()
    races = []
    order = re.findall(r"\[career\] f=\d+ (\S+): teleport to marker type 13|racewin: player \(racer \d+ of \d+, "
                       r"was \d+\.\) finished, position (\d+)|\[bot\] f=\d+ (\S+) was lost", txt)
    cur = None
    for tgt, pos, lost in order:
        if tgt:
            cur = tgt
        elif pos and cur:
            races.append([cur, int(pos)])
            cur = None
        elif lost:
            for r in reversed(races):     # drift on points: finished first, lost the event
                if r[0] == lost:
                    r[1] = "lost"
                    break
    fps = [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"^\[status\] .* fps=([\d.]+)", txt, re.M)]
    st = re.findall(r"\[career\] f=\d+ stage (\d+) bank \$(\d+)", txt)
    # "heap N MB live, VA M MB" since round 2's integration review; before it
    # "heap N MB" was the reserved VA (the bump pointer before the heap track)
    done = re.search(r"segment done: (\d+) (?:races|events) won this launch, heap (\d+) MB(?: live, VA (\d+) MB)?, "
                     r"max rss (\d+) MB", txt)
    rss = re.findall(r"rss=(\d+)MB", txt)
    diag = sorted(set(re.findall(r"^(\[trap\].*|\[hle\] UNIMPLEMENTED.*|.*UNRESOLVED INDIRECT.*|\*\*\* FAULT IN GUEST.*|"
                                 r".*GUEST MEMORY FAULT.*|.*HOST SEGV.*|.*TIME LIMIT REACHED.*)$", txt, re.M)))
    # a cover shoot is reached by a jump onto its marker or, with NFSU2_CAREER_BOT_DRIVE=1, by driving
    shows = list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r"\[career\] f=\d+ showcase (\S+): (?:teleport|drive onto)", txt)))
    skipped = re.findall(r"\[bot\] f=\d+ (\S+): no engage dialog, skipped", txt)
    skipped += [f"{s} (not offered: visual rating)" for s in re.findall(r"\[bot\] f=\d+ (\S+) not offered", txt)]
    complete = "career complete" in txt
    return dict(races=races, fps=fps, stage=st[-1] if st else None, done=done, rss=rss[-1] if rss else "?",
                diag=diag, shows=shows, skipped=skipped, complete=complete)

def main():
    segs = []
    for d in sys.argv[1:]:
        segs += sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(d, "seg*/log.txt")))
    grid = collections.Counter()
    print("| segment | races (finish position, or lost on points) | stage, bank at end | fps min / median | heap at end | max RSS | diagnostics |")
    print("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for log in segs:
        r = seg_report(log)
        name = os.path.relpath(os.path.dirname(log), os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(log))))
        for rn, pos in r["races"]:
            s, k = race_kind(rn)
            if pos == 1:
                grid[(s, k)] += 1
            elif pos == "lost":
                grid[(s, k + " (lost)")] += 1
        races = ", ".join(f"{rn} ({p})" for rn, p in r["races"]) or "-"
        fps = f"{min(r['fps']):.0f} / {statistics.median(r['fps']):.0f}" if r["fps"] else "-"
        stage = f"{r['stage'][0]}, ${r['stage'][1]}" if r["stage"] else "-"
        if not r["done"]:
            heap = "(career complete)" if r["complete"] else "(no clean end)"
        elif r["done"].group(3):
            heap = f"{r['done'].group(2)} MB (VA {r['done'].group(3)} MB)"
        else:
            heap = f"VA {r['done'].group(2)} MB"
        rss = f"{r['done'].group(4)} MB" if r["done"] else f"{r['rss']} MB"
        diag = "; ".join(x.strip()[:80] for x in r["diag"]) or "none"
        if r["skipped"]:
            diag += "; skipped: " + ", ".join(r["skipped"])
        print(f"| {name} | {races} | {stage} | {fps} | {heap} | {rss} | {diag} |")
    print()
    kinds = sorted({k for _, k in grid})
    stages = sorted({s for s, _ in grid if s is not None})
    print("| stage | " + " | ".join(kinds) + " |")
    print("|---|" + "---|" * len(kinds))
    for s in stages:
        print(f"| {s} | " + " | ".join(str(grid.get((s, k), "")) for k in kinds) + " |")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/bin/bash
# TEST-ONLY: play the career with the career bot (runtime/career.c) in
# segments, one game launch per segment.  Each segment loads the save the
# previous one left behind, so a crash costs one segment and every boundary
# also exercises save, quit, relaunch and load.
#   tools/career_segments.sh <outdir> <save-seed-dir> <segments> [VAR=value ...]
# Defaults per segment: NFSU2_CAREER_BOT_RACES=3, NFSU2_TIMEOUT=900 and
# NFSU2_CAREER_BOT_VISUAL=10: the bot buys no visual parts, and a DVD cover
# shoot is only offered once the car's visual rating reaches its need, so
# without the rating tweak the stage-5 shoots (KONIG's contract asks for all
# four; S5_URL_9 and then the final S5_CIRCUIT_36 only appear once they are
# done) never open and the career stalls in stage 5
# (NFSU2_CAREER_BOT_VISUAL=0: the car's own rating).  Stops (exit 0) after
# the segment that completes the career ("career complete", stage 6), and
# (exit 1) at the first other segment that does not end with "segment
# done".  Writes
# <outdir>/segNN/ (log, dumps, contact.png, save/) and <outdir>/summary.txt.
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
OUT="${1:?usage: tools/career_segments.sh <outdir> <save-seed-dir> <segments> [VAR=value ...]}"
SEED="${2:?save seed dir}"; N="${3:?number of segments}"; shift 3
mkdir -p "$OUT"; OUT="$(cd "$OUT" && pwd)"
# game data: NFSU2_DATA, else ../../work/gamedata or ../../gamedata from the checkout
W="$ROOT/../../work"; [ -d "$W/gamedata" ] || W="$ROOT/../.."
export NFSU2_DATA="${NFSU2_DATA:-$W/gamedata}"
export NFSU2_REGFILE_SEED="${NFSU2_REGFILE_SEED:-$ROOT/tests/web/seed/registry_perf4_native.txt}"
[ -f "$NFSU2_REGFILE_SEED" ] || { echo "registry seed not found: $NFSU2_REGFILE_SEED" >&2; exit 1; }
first=1; [ -f "$OUT/next_seg" ] && first=$(cat "$OUT/next_seg")
prev="$SEED"; [ "$first" -gt 1 ] && prev="$OUT/seg$(printf %02d $((first - 1)))/save"
for ((i = first; i < first + N; i++)); do
  d="$OUT/seg$(printf %02d $i)"; rm -rf "$d"
  NFSU2_SAVE_SEED="$prev" "$ROOT/tools/autorun.sh" "$d" NOFOCUS=2 NFSU2_FNG_LOG=1 \
     NFSU2_STATUS_EVERY=1200 NFSU2_DUMP_SCALE=0.3 NFSU2_DUMP_FRAMES=%3600 \
     NFSU2_CAREER_BOT=1 NFSU2_CAREER_BOT_RACES=3 NFSU2_CAREER_BOT_VISUAL=10 NFSU2_TIMEOUT=900 "$@" > "$d.run" 2>&1 < /dev/null
  rc=$?; log="$d/log.txt"
  "$ROOT/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/tools/contact_sheet.py" "$d" 5 260 > /dev/null 2>&1
  st=$(LC_ALL=C grep -a "^\[status\]" "$log" | tail -1 | sed 's/^\[status\] //')
  cl=$(LC_ALL=C grep -a "\[career\] f=[0-9]* stage" "$log" | tail -1 | sed 's/^\[career\] //' | cut -c1-160)
  bad=$(LC_ALL=C grep -a -c "FAULT IN GUEST\|GUEST MEMORY FAULT\|HOST SEGV\|TIME LIMIT REACHED\|^\[trap\]\|UNRESOLVED INDIRECT\|UNIMPLEMENTED" "$log")
  printf 'seg%02d rc=%d bad=%s | %s | %s\n' "$i" "$rc" "$bad" "$cl" "$st" | tee -a "$OUT/summary.txt"
  if [ $rc -eq 0 ] && LC_ALL=C grep -aq "career complete" "$log"; then   # stage 6: nothing left
    echo "seg$(printf %02d $i): career complete" | tee -a "$OUT/summary.txt"; echo $((i + 1)) > "$OUT/next_seg"; exit 0
  fi
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || ! LC_ALL=C grep -aq "segment done" "$log"; then
    echo "seg$(printf %02d $i): stopped (see $log)" | tee -a "$OUT/summary.txt"; echo "$i" > "$OUT/next_seg"; exit 1
  fi
  prev="$d/save"; echo $((i + 1)) > "$OUT/next_seg"
done

"""Verify split-screen operand sites against the user's original executable.

Run with the build environment's capstone and pefile, before regenerating.
This reads the executable; it never patches or redistributes game bytes.
"""
import sys
import capstone
import pefile
from capstone.x86_const import X86_OP_IMM, X86_OP_MEM
from split_reloc import SETTINGS_READERS

pe = pefile.PE(sys.argv[1])
base = pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase
decoder = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_X86, capstone.CS_MODE_32)
decoder.detail = True

def operands(address):
    insn = next(decoder.disasm(pe.get_data(address - base, 16), address))
    return [op.imm if op.type == X86_OP_IMM else op.mem.disp
            for op in insn.operands if op.type in (X86_OP_IMM, X86_OP_MEM)]

for address in SETTINGS_READERS:
    values = operands(address)
    assert any(0x83aa64 <= v < 0x83aab4 for v in values), (hex(address), values)
for address in (0x48cd61, 0x48cd6b, 0x48cd90, 0x48cd9c):
    assert 0x64000 in operands(address), hex(address)
assert 2 in operands(0x4856c7)
print(f'Validated {len(SETTINGS_READERS)} settings readers, four scratch sizes and the human manager capacity.')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Tile all frame dumps of a run directory into one labelled PNG.
   .venv/bin/python tools/contact_sheet.py <rundir> [cols] [thumb_width]"""
import sys, glob, os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
d = sys.argv[1]; cols = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 4
tw = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 480
fs = sorted(f for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(d, 'nfsu2_*.png')))
if not fs: sys.exit('no dumps')
ims = []
for f in fs:
    im = Image.open(f).convert('RGB'); th = int(im.height * tw / im.width)
    ims.append((os.path.basename(f)[6:-4], im.resize((tw, th))))
th = max(i.height for _, i in ims) + 18
rows = (len(ims) + cols - 1) // cols
W = Image.new('RGB', (cols * tw, rows * th), (40, 40, 40)); dr = ImageDraw.Draw(W)
for k, (lab, im) in enumerate(ims):
    x, y = (k % cols) * tw, (k // cols) * th
    W.paste(im, (x, y + 18)); dr.text((x + 4, y + 3), lab, fill=(255, 255, 0))
out = os.path.join(d, 'contact.png'); W.save(out); print(out, len(ims), 'frames')

"""Crash damage's scratches in the game folder: MODPACKS/DAMAGE/SCRATCHES.TPK, a mod pack's file (runtime/fileio.c).

    tools/damagepack.py <game folder or out folder>

It is Crashing Foreign Cars' own texture pack of DAMAGE_SCRATCH1..4 (FRS Mods' tools/build_pack.py: the bare metal
with the scratches in the alpha, four strengths, DXT5), tools/damage/scratches.tpk, as the game's LoadChunks takes it.
runtime/damage.c reads it only while the crash damage is on, so the browser fetches it only then (the page's preload
too: web/src/host/datacache.ts); without it the dents come without scratches.  The server serves it with the rest of
MODPACKS/ (web/server-rs manifest.rs GAME_ENTRIES).  It is checked as the game reads it (tools/packcheck.py) before it
is written."""
import os
import struct
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import packcheck  # noqa: E402

SRC = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'damage', 'scratches.tpk')
REL = os.path.join('MODPACKS', 'DAMAGE', 'SCRATCHES.TPK')
TPK_CHUNK = 0xB3300000


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    data = open(SRC, 'rb').read()
    chunk, size = struct.unpack_from('<II', data)
    if chunk != TPK_CHUNK or size + 8 != len(data):
        sys.exit(f'{SRC}: not one texture pack chunk (0x{chunk:08X}, {size + 8} of {len(data)} bytes)')
    bad = packcheck.check(None, {REL.replace(os.sep, '/'): data})    # as runtime/damage.c and the game's loader read it
    if bad: sys.exit(f'{SRC}: not written, tools/packcheck.py says: ' + '; '.join(why for _, why in bad))
    out = os.path.join(sys.argv[1], REL)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
    if os.path.exists(out) and open(out, 'rb').read() == data:
        print(f'{out}: as it is ({len(data)} bytes)')
        return
    tmp = out + '.tmp'
    with open(tmp, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(data)
    os.replace(tmp, out)
    print(f'{out}: {len(data)} bytes')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Drift scoring rules over a per-frame "[trace]" log (tests/scripts/drift_score.txt):
the accrual law, banking and the crash loss, checked wherever they occur.

The vanilla rule (Style::Update 0x56E920 via 0x56C740): while the human racer's first style is starting or drifting
(state 1 or 0), every frame adds 120 * rate * multiplier * dt to the pending
points, where rate and multiplier are those of the previous frame's report and
dt is this frame's world step -- but only if 2 * dt > age, age being the
WorldTimer time (1/4000 s ticks) since that report (style +0x34).

Checks every pair of consecutive traced frames in which the drift continues
(state 0/1 in both).  The WorldTimer of the later frame's update is its traced
value wt (read at Present, before the timer advances; it equals the stamp of
every report made in that frame), so the gate is known exactly: the law must
hold if it is open, nothing may be added if it is shut.  Without a wt field
the stamp of a report in the later frame stands in for it; a frame without
report then only has to follow the law or add nothing.  One more vanilla case:
a starting drift (state 1) whose last report is older than the 0.3 s timeout
fails back to idle in Style::Update (0x56D5C0: pending 0, state 2), and a
report later in the same frame starts it again (0x56EAB0: state 1, stamp =
wt), so the pair reads 1 -> 1 with the pending points back at 0.  Fails on
any other frame, or when fewer than --min frames accrued (the check would be
vacuous).
Needs the trace fields pend, srate, mult, st, dtw, stamp (and wt).

Banking and loss (0x56E920, 0x56D500, 0x56D5C0, DriftCar::Update 0x56ED40),
checked on every occurrence when the fields tot and crash are traced:
  - the first style's total changes only when a drift banks (state 0 -> 3),
    by (int) of the pending points, and only once its last report is older
    than the 0.3 s timeout;
  - a drift lost to a crash (state 0 -> 4) has the crash flag set, and the
    pending points are gone (0) when the style leaves state 4.
An open-loop scenario does not always crash, so no loss is required.
Usage: drift_accrual.py LOG [--min N]"""
import re, struct, sys

def f32(x):
    return struct.unpack('<f', struct.pack('<f', x))[0]

def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    need = 20
    if '--min' in args:
        k = args.index('--min'); need = int(args[k + 1]); del args[k:k + 2]
    rows = []
    for line in open(args[0], errors='replace'):
        m = re.search(r'\[trace\] f=(\d+) t=\d+ w=([-0-9.]+) (.*)', line)
        if not m:
            continue
        d = {'f': int(m.group(1))}
        for kv in m.group(3).split():
            k, _, v = kv.partition('=')
            try:
                d[k] = float(v)
            except ValueError:
                d[k] = None
        rows.append(d)
    keys = ('pend', 'srate', 'mult', 'st', 'dtw', 'stamp')
    if not rows or any(k not in rows[0] for k in keys):
        print(f"[accrual] FAIL: no trace with the fields {keys}")
        return 1
    law = gated = idle = restart = bad = 0
    for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        if b['f'] != a['f'] + 1 or any(a.get(k) is None or b.get(k) is None for k in keys):
            continue
        if a['st'] not in (0, 1) or b['st'] not in (0, 1):
            continue
        exp = 120.0 * a['srate'] * a['mult'] * b['dtw']
        dp = b['pend'] - a['pend']
        if exp <= 0:
            continue
        tol = 1e-3 + 2e-6 * abs(b['pend'])            # pending is a float32
        holds = abs(dp - exp) <= tol + 1e-4 * exp
        zero = abs(dp) <= tol
        now = b.get('wt') if b.get('wt') is not None else (b['stamp'] if b['stamp'] != a['stamp'] else None)
        if now is not None:
            # the gate, in the game's single precision: age = ticks * 0.00025f
            age = f32((now - a['stamp']) * f32(0.00025))
            two_dt = 2.0 * f32(b['dtw'])
            if a['st'] == 1 and b['st'] == 1 and age > f32(0.3) and b['stamp'] == now \
                    and abs(b['pend']) <= 1e-3:
                restart += 1; continue        # timed out, then started again by this frame's report
            if two_dt > age and holds:
                law += 1; continue
            if two_dt <= age and zero:
                gated += 1; continue
            what = f"2*dt {1000 * two_dt:.3f} ms vs age {1000 * age:.3f} ms"
        else:
            if holds:
                law += 1; continue
            if zero:
                idle += 1; continue
            what = "no report in this frame"
        bad += 1
        if bad <= 10:
            print(f"[accrual] f={b['f']}: pending +{dp:.6g}, expected +{exp:.6g} ({what})")
    ok = bad == 0 and law >= need
    print(f"[accrual] {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {law} frames follow 120*rate*mult*dt, "
          f"{gated} shut by the 2*dt > age gate, {idle} without accrual or report, "
          f"{restart} starts timed out and restarted, {bad} violations (need >= {need} accruing frames)")
    rok, banks, losses = rules(rows)
    print(f"[drift] {'PASS' if ok and rok else 'FAIL'}: accrual {'ok' if ok else 'FAILED'} "
          f"({law} frames), {banks} banks and {losses} crash losses "
          f"{'follow the rules' if rok else 'BREAK the rules'}")
    return 0 if ok and rok else 1

def rules(rows):
    """Banking and crash-loss checks; returns (ok, banks, losses)."""
    if not rows or any(k not in rows[0] for k in ('tot', 'crash', 'wt')):
        print("[rules] FAIL: the trace lacks tot, crash or wt")
        return False, 0, 0
    banks = losses = bad = 0
    def fail(f, msg):
        nonlocal bad
        bad += 1
        if bad <= 10:
            print(f"[rules] f={f}: {msg}")
    for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        if b['f'] != a['f'] + 1 or any(r.get(k) is None for r in (a, b)
                                       for k in ('st', 'pend', 'tot', 'crash', 'stamp', 'wt')):
            continue
        dtot = b['tot'] - a['tot']
        if a['st'] == 0 and b['st'] == 3:
            banks += 1
            age = f32((b['wt'] - a['stamp']) * f32(0.00025))
            if dtot != int(a['pend']):
                fail(b['f'], f"banked {dtot:g}, pending was {a['pend']:.6g}")
            if age <= 0.29:
                fail(b['f'], f"banked {1000 * age:.1f} ms after the last report (timeout 300 ms)")
        elif dtot != 0:
            fail(b['f'], f"total changed by {dtot:g} without a bank (state {a['st']:g} -> {b['st']:g})")
        if a['st'] == 0 and b['st'] == 4:
            losses += 1
            if not b['crash']:
                fail(b['f'], "drift lost (state 4) without the crash flag")
        if a['st'] == 4 and b['st'] != 4 and abs(b['pend']) > 1e-3:
            fail(b['f'], f"left the lost state with {b['pend']:.6g} points pending")
    print(f"[rules] {'PASS' if not bad else 'FAIL'}: {banks} banks, {losses} crash losses, {bad} violations")
    return bad == 0, banks, losses

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare the per-frame drift traces of two or more runs.

    tools/drift_compare.py <run_dir_or_log> <run_dir_or_log> [...]  [--fields x,y,z,...]

Each log must contain "[trace] f=.. t=.. w=.. name=value ..." lines from the
autotest "trace" command (tests/scripts/drift_traj.txt).  Rows are matched by
world time since the run's first trace line (the scripts start the trace at
GO).  The traced w is world ms since the process started, front end
included (framerate.c hfr_sim_ms), so it differs between runs by seconds;
only the offset from the first line is compared, to 0.1 ms.  Runs with a
fixed world step (NFSU2_FIXED_DT) then line up frame by frame even if the
menus and loading took a different number of frames.  The printed w values
are those offsets.  For every run after the first it prints the first world
time where any traced value differs from the first run, the largest
difference per field, the drift summary (drifts, banked points, best pending)
and the final scores.
"""
import sys, os, re, math

def load(path):
    if os.path.isdir(path):
        path = os.path.join(path, 'log.txt')
    rows = {}
    rx = re.compile(r'\[trace\] f=(\d+) t=(\d+) w=([-0-9.]+) (.*)')
    w0 = None
    with open(path, errors='replace') as f:
        for line in f:
            m = rx.search(line)
            if not m:
                continue
            if w0 is None:
                w0 = float(m.group(3))
            w = round(float(m.group(3)) - w0, 1)
            vals = {}
            for kv in m.group(4).split():
                k, _, v = kv.partition('=')
                try:
                    vals[k] = float(v) if v not in ('?', '') else None
                except ValueError:
                    vals[k] = None
            rows[w] = vals
    return rows

def summary(rows):
    ws = sorted(rows)
    drifts, best, starts = 0, 0.0, 0
    last_st = None
    for w in ws:
        r = rows[w]
        st = r.get('st')
        if st is not None and last_st is not None and st != last_st and st == 0:
            drifts += 1
        if st == 1 and last_st != 1:
            starts += 1
        last_st = st
        if r.get('pend') is not None:
            best = max(best, r['pend'])
    fin = rows[ws[-1]] if ws else {}
    return dict(frames=len(ws), drifts=drifts, starts=starts, best_pending=best,
                total=fin.get('tot'), ai=[fin.get('a%d' % i) for i in range(4)],
                w_end=ws[-1] if ws else 0)

def main():
    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if not a.startswith('--')]
    fields = None
    for a in sys.argv[1:]:
        if a.startswith('--fields='):
            fields = a.split('=', 1)[1].split(',')
    runs = [(a, load(a)) for a in args]
    base_name, base = runs[0]
    for name, rows in runs:
        s = summary(rows)
        print(f"{name}: {s['frames']} frames to w={s['w_end']:.0f} ms; drifts counted {s['drifts']}, "
              f"started {s['starts']}, best pending {s['best_pending']:.1f}, banked total {s['total']}, "
              f"AI totals {s['ai']}")
    for name, rows in runs[1:]:
        common = sorted(set(base) & set(rows))
        if not common:
            print(f"{name}: no common world times with {base_name}"); continue
        keys = fields or [k for k in base[common[0]] if k in rows[common[0]]]
        first = None; maxd = {k: 0.0 for k in keys}; maxw = {k: None for k in keys}
        for w in common:
            a, b = base[w], rows[w]
            for k in keys:
                x, y = a.get(k), b.get(k)
                if x is None or y is None:
                    continue
                d = abs(x - y)
                if d > 0 and first is None:
                    first = (w, k, x, y)
                if d > maxd[k]:
                    maxd[k] = d; maxw[k] = w
        print(f"\n{name} vs {base_name}: {len(common)} common frames")
        if first is None:
            print("  identical on every traced value")
        else:
            print(f"  first difference at w={first[0]:.3f} ms: {first[1]} {first[2]!r} vs {first[3]!r}")
            for k in keys:
                if maxd[k] > 0:
                    print(f"  max |d{k}| = {maxd[k]:.6g} (at w={maxw[k]:.0f} ms)")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the app icon (.icns) from SPEED2.EXE's own icon resource.

The exe carries one icon group, IDI_ICON1, with a single 32x32 24-bit image
(the grey NFS logo; the NFSU_icon.ico next to it is the same picture).  It
is enlarged in nearest-neighbour steps, so it stays crisp pixel art instead
of a blur, cut to the macOS icon shape (an 824 px rounded tile on the 1024
grid, with a soft shadow) and written in every size iconutil wants.  For
personal use: the artwork is EA's.

Usage:  tools/exeicon.py <SPEED2.EXE> <out.icns> [<preview.png>]
"""
import io, os, struct, subprocess, sys, tempfile
import pefile
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter

RT_ICON, RT_GROUP_ICON = 3, 14
CANVAS, TILE, RADIUS = 1024, 824, 185          # Big Sur+ icon grid


def exe_icons(path):
    """All images of the exe's first icon group, as (w, h, bpp, bytes)."""
    pe = pefile.PE(path, fast_load=True)
    pe.parse_data_directories(directories=[pefile.DIRECTORY_ENTRY['IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_RESOURCE']])
    icons, group = {}, None
    for t in pe.DIRECTORY_ENTRY_RESOURCE.entries:
        for e in t.directory.entries:
            for lang in e.directory.entries:
                d = lang.data.struct
                raw = pe.get_data(d.OffsetToData, d.Size)
                if t.id == RT_ICON:
                    icons[e.id] = raw
                elif t.id == RT_GROUP_ICON and group is None:
                    group = raw
    if group is None:
        sys.exit("exeicon: no icon group in %s" % path)
    _, _, count = struct.unpack_from('<HHH', group)
    out = []
    for i in range(count):
        w, h, _, _, _, bpp, size, iid = struct.unpack_from('<BBBBHHIH', group, 6 + 14 * i)
        if iid in icons:
            out.append((w or 256, h or 256, bpp, icons[iid]))
    return out


def decode(w, h, bpp, raw):
    """One RT_ICON image (PNG or BMP DIB with AND mask) -> RGBA."""
    if raw[:8] == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n':
        return Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)).convert('RGBA')
    # Wrap the DIB in a one-image .ico and let Pillow apply the AND mask.
    ico = struct.pack('<HHH', 0, 1, 1) + struct.pack('<BBBBHHII', w & 255, h & 255, 0, 0, 1, bpp,
                                                    len(raw), 22) + raw
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(ico))
    im.size = (w, h)
    return im.convert('RGBA')


def master(art):
    """The 1024x1024 icon: art enlarged to the tile, rounded, with a shadow."""
    k = -(-TILE // art.width)                      # integer factor >= tile
    big = art.resize((art.width * k, art.height * k), Image.NEAREST)
    tile = big.resize((TILE, TILE), Image.LANCZOS)
    mask = Image.new('L', (TILE * 4, TILE * 4), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle([0, 0, TILE * 4 - 1, TILE * 4 - 1], radius=RADIUS * 4, fill=255)
    mask = mask.resize((TILE, TILE), Image.LANCZOS)
    tile.putalpha(Image.composite(tile.getchannel('A'), Image.new('L', tile.size, 0), mask))

    off = (CANVAS - TILE) // 2
    shadow = Image.new('L', (CANVAS, CANVAS), 0)
    shadow.paste(mask.point(lambda v: v * 0.45), (off, off + 12))
    shadow = shadow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(14))
    img = Image.new('RGBA', (CANVAS, CANVAS), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    img.putalpha(shadow)
    img.alpha_composite(tile, (off, off))
    return img


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 3:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    exe, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    imgs = exe_icons(exe)
    w, h, bpp, raw = max(imgs, key=lambda t: (t[0] * t[1], t[2]))
    art = decode(w, h, bpp, raw)
    img = master(art)
    if len(sys.argv) > 3:
        img.save(sys.argv[3])
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        iconset = os.path.join(td, 'AppIcon.iconset')
        os.mkdir(iconset)
        for px in (16, 32, 128, 256, 512):
            img.resize((px, px), Image.LANCZOS).save(os.path.join(iconset, 'icon_%dx%d.png' % (px, px)))
            img.resize((px * 2, px * 2), Image.LANCZOS).save(os.path.join(iconset, 'icon_%dx%d@2x.png' % (px, px)))
        subprocess.run(['iconutil', '-c', 'icns', iconset, '-o', out], check=True)
    print('icon: %s (from %s: %dx%d, %d-bit, IDI_ICON1)' % (out, os.path.basename(exe), w, h, bpp))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inter-procedural flag liveness (ABI): are the flags really live at call and
return points?

Code generated by MSVC does not read a flag returned by a call, and the callee
does not read the caller's flags on entry.  The lifter, though, treats all flags
as live at calls and at ret (conservative): the six flags of the last
flag-setting instruction before a call are always computed and stored.  This
tool PROVES the assumption:

  live_in[f]  : flags read at f's entry (before they are defined)
  flags_out   : targets of direct calls after which a flag is read
  indirect_rd : indirect call sites after which a flag is read
(the JSON keys have the same names)

Fixed point: call T -> defines F_ALL, uses live_in[T] (indirect: F_ALL);
ret -> live 0, or F_ALL if f is in flags_out.

    ./.venv/bin/python tools/flagabi.py <SPEED2.EXE> [output.json]

output.json is passed to genall.py as FLAGABI=<json> (see lift.flag_liveness).
"""
import sys, os, json, collections, time, multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from lift import Lifter, abi_cfg, abi_liveness, F_ALL
from capstone.x86 import X86_OP_IMM

EXE = sys.argv[1]
_L = None

def _init():
    global _L
    _L = Lifter(EXE, comments=False)

def summarize(a):
    try:
        blocks, calls = _L.discover(a)
    except Exception:
        return a, None
    return a, abi_cfg(blocks, _L.in_text, _L.jtab)


def analyse(G):
    """fixed point -> (live_in, flags_out, indirect_rd)"""
    live_in = {a: 0 for a in G}
    flags_out = set()
    for round_no in range(16):
        changed = False
        new_out = set(); indirect_rd = []
        for a, g in G.items():
            ent, _, call_after = abi_liveness(g, a, live_in, a in flags_out)
            if ent != live_in[a]:
                live_in[a] = ent; changed = True
            for site, (cur, kind, target) in call_after.items():
                if cur:
                    if kind == 1: new_out.add(target)
                    else: indirect_rd.append((a, site, cur))
        if new_out - flags_out:
            flags_out |= new_out; changed = True
        print(f'  round {round_no}: live at entry {sum(1 for v in live_in.values() if v)}, '
              f'returning flags {len(flags_out)}, reading after an indirect call {len(indirect_rd)}')
        if not changed: break
    return live_in, flags_out, indirect_rd


if __name__ == '__main__':
    out_path = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'out/flagabi.json'
    t0 = time.time()
    sys.argv = sys.argv[:2]            # genall expects argv[2]=NSHARD
    import genall                      # discover_all: genall.EXE = sys.argv[1]
    funcs = genall.discover_all()[0]   # every entry, jump-table targets included: a superset of what is lifted
    print(f'{len(funcs)} functions ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)')
    with mp.Pool(mp.cpu_count(), initializer=_init) as pool:
        G = dict(pool.map(summarize, funcs, chunksize=64))
    G = {a: g for a, g in G.items() if g}
    print(f'summary: {len(G)} functions ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)')
    live_in, flags_out, indirect_rd = analyse(G)
    json.dump({'live_in': {hex(a): v for a, v in live_in.items() if v}, 'flags_out': sorted(hex(a) for a in flags_out),
               'indirect_rd': [[hex(a), hex(site), cur] for a, site, cur in indirect_rd]}, open(out_path, 'w'), indent=0)
    print(f'written: {out_path}  ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)')
    for a, site, cur in indirect_rd[:20]:
        print(f'  reads flags after an indirect call: function {a:#x} call {site:#x} mask {cur:#x}')
    for a in sorted(flags_out)[:30]:
        print(f'  returns flags: {a:#x}')
    for a, v in sorted(live_in.items())[:0]: pass
    print('live at entry:', ' '.join(f'{a:#x}:{v:#x}' for a, v in sorted(live_in.items()) if v)[:2000])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The start page's Full Scene Anti-Aliasing question's picture (web/src/app/shell.ts askFsaa): the player's car at a
Quick Race's start, its roof, rear window, wiper and mirror, zoomed 4x without smoothing, once with the game's FSAA
off and once on.  Made from two frame dumps of the game, so the pictures are the game's and live in the server's game
folder beside the texture packs (TEXPACKS/fsaa-off.webp, TEXPACKS/fsaa-on.webp), never in this repository.

The two frames: tests/web/scripts/fsaa_pics.txt on /test/play.html at w=1280&h=720&dumpscale=1, once with
reg=/tests/web/seed/registry_perf4_native.txt (FSAA off) and once with reg=/tests/web/seed/registry_perf4_fsaa.txt
(on); its dump fsaa_a (fsaa_b: the same moment 3 frames later, should a dump be dropped).

    python3 tools/fsaapics.py <off.png> <on.png> <out folder>   (writes <out folder>/TEXPACKS/fsaa-{off,on}.webp)
    [--box X,Y,W,H] the part of the 1280x720 frame (default 525,400,200,100: 2:1, as the question shows it)
    [--scale N]     its zoom (default 4: 800x400, the question's 400x200 at two device pixels a pixel)

Needs Pillow (the repo's .venv).  Lossless WebP: the zoomed pixels' edges are the point.
"""
import argparse
import os
import sys

from PIL import Image


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split('\n\n')[0])
    ap.add_argument('off'); ap.add_argument('on'); ap.add_argument('out')
    ap.add_argument('--box', default='525,400,200,100')
    ap.add_argument('--scale', type=int, default=4)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    x, y, w, h = (int(v) for v in a.box.split(','))
    dest = os.path.join(a.out, 'TEXPACKS')
    os.makedirs(dest, exist_ok=True)
    for tag, src in (('off', a.off), ('on', a.on)):
        im = Image.open(src).convert('RGB')
        if im.size != (1280, 720):
            print(f'{src}: {im.size[0]}x{im.size[1]}, not the 1280x720 dump the box is for', file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        part = im.crop((x, y, x + w, y + h)).resize((w * a.scale, h * a.scale), Image.NEAREST)
        path = os.path.join(dest, f'fsaa-{tag}.webp')
        part.save(path, 'WEBP', lossless=True, method=6)
        print(f'{path}: {part.width}x{part.height}, {os.path.getsize(path)} bytes')
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""DIFFERENTIAL test for x86 semantics: real x86 (Rosetta) vs the lifter.

The same instruction bytes run in two places:
  1) oracle : compiled as x86-64, runs under Rosetta    -> the real CPU
  2) guest  : translated to C by RawLifter, runs on ARM64 -> our output
The outputs (6 GPRs + flags + 128 bytes of memory) are compared.

Encodings that mean the same in 64-bit mode are used:
  - eax..esi only (no REX, no r8+)
  - memory is always N(%rdi) / [edi+N]
  - edi and esp are NOT USED as destinations
"""
import os, sys, random, struct, subprocess, hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'tools')
from lift import RawLifter, Unsupported

SCRATCH = 0x00A00000          # address of the memory buffer in the guest
MEMSZ   = 128
BASE    = 0x00400000

R32 = ['%eax','%ecx','%edx','%ebx','%ebp','%esi']
R16 = ['%ax','%cx','%dx','%bx','%bp','%si']
R8  = ['%al','%cl','%dl','%bl','%ah','%ch']      # ah/ch: the high-byte forms
XMM = ['%xmm0','%xmm1','%xmm2','%xmm3']

# flag mask: CF PF AF ZF SF OF  (+DF is kept separately)
F_CF,F_PF,F_AF,F_ZF,F_SF,F_OF = 1,4,0x10,0x40,0x80,0x800
F_ALL = F_CF|F_PF|F_AF|F_ZF|F_SF|F_OF

def M(rng, lo=0, hi=96, align=4):
    off = rng.randrange(lo, hi, align)
    return f"{off}(%rdi)"

class Tmpl:
    def __init__(self, name, gen, undef=0, skipmem=False, ptr=False):
        self.name, self.gen, self.undef = name, gen, undef
        self.skipmem, self.ptr = skipmem, ptr

T = []
def tmpl(name, undef=0, skipmem=False, ptr=False):
    """skipmem: the result depends on the precision difference between 80-bit
    x87 and double (fprem, fsin...) -- the memory result is not compared."""
    def d(f): T.append(Tmpl(name, f, undef, skipmem, ptr)); return f
    return d

# ---------------- integer core ----------------
ARITH = ['add','sub','adc','sbb','and','or','xor','cmp']
for op in ARITH:
    @tmpl(f"{op} r32,r32")
    def _(rng, op=op): return f"{op}l {rng.choice(R32)}, {rng.choice(R32)}"
    @tmpl(f"{op} m32,r32")
    def _(rng, op=op): return f"{op}l {M(rng)}, {rng.choice(R32)}"
    @tmpl(f"{op} r32,m32")
    def _(rng, op=op): return f"{op}l {rng.choice(R32)}, {M(rng)}"
    @tmpl(f"{op} imm32,r32")
    def _(rng, op=op): return f"{op}l ${rng.getrandbits(32)}, {rng.choice(R32)}"
    @tmpl(f"{op} imm8,r32")
    def _(rng, op=op): return f"{op}l ${rng.randrange(-128,128)}, {rng.choice(R32)}"
    @tmpl(f"{op} r16,r16")
    def _(rng, op=op): return f"{op}w {rng.choice(R16)}, {rng.choice(R16)}"
    @tmpl(f"{op} r8,r8")
    def _(rng, op=op): return f"{op}b {rng.choice(R8)}, {rng.choice(R8)}"
    @tmpl(f"{op} m8,r8")
    def _(rng, op=op): return f"{op}b {M(rng,0,96,1)}, {rng.choice(R8)}"

@tmpl("test r32,r32")
def _(rng): return f"testl {rng.choice(R32)}, {rng.choice(R32)}"
@tmpl("test imm32,r32")
def _(rng): return f"testl ${rng.getrandbits(32)}, {rng.choice(R32)}"
@tmpl("inc/dec r32")
def _(rng): return f"{rng.choice(['incl','decl'])} {rng.choice(R32)}"
@tmpl("inc/dec m32")
def _(rng): return f"{rng.choice(['incl','decl'])} {M(rng)}"
@tmpl("neg/not r32")
def _(rng): return f"{rng.choice(['negl','notl'])} {rng.choice(R32)}"
@tmpl("neg/not r8")
def _(rng): return f"{rng.choice(['negb','notb'])} {rng.choice(R8)}"

# ---------------- shift / rotate ----------------
for op in ['shl','shr','sar','rol','ror','rcl','rcr']:
    @tmpl(f"{op} imm,r32", undef=F_OF|F_AF)
    def _(rng, op=op): return f"{op}l ${rng.randrange(0,33)}, {rng.choice(R32)}"
    @tmpl(f"{op} cl,r32", undef=F_OF|F_AF)
    def _(rng, op=op): return f"{op}l %cl, {rng.choice(R32)}"
    @tmpl(f"{op} imm,r16", undef=F_OF|F_AF)

    @tmpl(f"{op} imm,r8", undef=F_OF|F_AF)

@tmpl("shld/shrd", undef=F_OF|F_AF)

# ---------------- string instructions (esi = source pointer) ----------------
@tmpl("movs/stos/lods", ptr=True)
def _(rng):

def assemble(asm_list, workdir):
    """Assemble all test instructions in one file, return their byte strings.

    NO separator byte is used: an instruction's own bytes can merge with the
    separator (example: `andb %cl,%ah` -> 20 CC).  Instead every test gets a
    global symbol and the boundaries are read from the symbol table."""
    src = ['.text']
    for i, a in enumerate(asm_list):
        src.append('.globl _c%d' % i)
        src.append('_c%d:' % i)
        src.append('\t' + a)
    src.append('.globl _cend')
    src.append('_cend:')
    src.append('\tnop')
    sfile = os.path.join(workdir, 'fuzz.s')
    ofile = os.path.join(workdir, 'fuzz.o')
    open(sfile, 'w').write('\n'.join(src) + '\n')
    subprocess.run(['clang','-arch','x86_64','-c','-o',ofile,sfile], check=True)

    nm = subprocess.run(['nm','-n',ofile], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    addr = {}
    for line in nm.splitlines():
        f = line.split()
        if len(f) >= 3 and f[2].startswith('_c'):
            try: addr[f[2]] = int(f[0], 16)
            except ValueError: pass

    raw = subprocess.run(['otool','-t',ofile], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    byts = bytearray()
    for line in raw.splitlines():
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) < 2: continue
        if not all(len(x) == 2 for x in parts[1:]): continue
        try: int(parts[0], 16)
        except ValueError: continue
        for x in parts[1:]: byts.append(int(x, 16))

    out = []
    for i in range(len(asm_list)):
        a0 = addr.get('_c%d' % i)
        a1 = addr.get('_c%d' % (i+1), addr.get('_cend'))
        if a0 is None or a1 is None or a1 <= a0:
            raise SystemExit('assemble: no boundary found for %d' % i)
        out.append(bytes(byts[a0:a1]))
    return out

ORACLE_C = """
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <setjmp.h>
#include <signal.h>
static sigjmp_buf g_jb;
static volatile int g_infault;
static void onfault(int sig){ (void)sig; if (g_infault) siglongjmp(g_jb, 1); _exit(9); }
typedef struct { uint32_t r[6]; uint32_t fl; uint32_t pad; uint8_t mem[@MEMSZ@]; } St;
extern const unsigned char CODE[];
extern const unsigned CODE_OFF[];
extern const unsigned CODE_LEN[];
extern const unsigned NCASE;
extern const unsigned char INIT[];
static void *page;
static void run_one(St *s, unsigned long long rsiv){
  __asm__ volatile(
    "pushq %%rbx\\n\\tpushq %%rbp\\n\\tpushq %%r12\\n\\tpushq %%r13\\n\\t"
    "movq %0, %%r12\\n\\tmovq %1, %%r13\\n\\t"
    "leaq 32(%%r12), %%rdi\\n\\t"
    "movl 0(%%r12), %%eax\\n\\tmovl 4(%%r12), %%ecx\\n\\t"
    "movl 8(%%r12), %%edx\\n\\tmovl 12(%%r12), %%ebx\\n\\t"
    "movl 16(%%r12), %%ebp\\n\\tmovl 20(%%r12), %%esi\\n\\t"
    "fninit\\n\\t"                    /* every case starts with a clean FPU */
    "xorps %%xmm0, %%xmm0\\n\\txorps %%xmm1, %%xmm1\\n\\t"
    "xorps %%xmm2, %%xmm2\\n\\txorps %%xmm3, %%xmm3\\n\\t"
    "movl 24(%%r12), %%r11d\\n\\tpushq %%r11\\n\\tpopfq\\n\\t"
    "callq *%%r13\\n\\t"
    "pushfq\\n\\tpopq %%r11\\n\\t"
    "movl %%eax, 0(%%r12)\\n\\tmovl %%ecx, 4(%%r12)\\n\\t"
    "movl %%edx, 8(%%r12)\\n\\tmovl %%ebx, 12(%%r12)\\n\\t"
    "movl %%ebp, 16(%%r12)\\n\\tmovl %%esi, 20(%%r12)\\n\\t"
    "movl %%r11d, 24(%%r12)\\n\\t"
    "popq %%r13\\n\\tpopq %%r12\\n\\tpopq %%rbp\\n\\tpopq %%rbx\\n\\t"
    :: "r"(s), "r"(page), "r"(rsiv) : "rax","rcx","rdx","rsi","rdi","r11","memory","cc",
       "xmm0","xmm1","xmm2","xmm3","st","st(1)","st(2)","st(3)");
}
int main(void){
  setvbuf(stdout, 0, _IOLBF, 0);
  /* Some random cases can fault on the real CPU (divide, access);
   * skip that case and go on, do not lose the whole run. */
  signal(SIGSEGV, onfault); signal(SIGBUS, onfault);
  signal(SIGFPE, onfault);  signal(SIGILL, onfault); signal(SIGTRAP, onfault);
  page = mmap(0, 1<<20, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE|PROT_EXEC, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANON, -1, 0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < NCASE; i++){
    unsigned char *p = (unsigned char*)page;
    memcpy(p, CODE + CODE_OFF[i], CODE_LEN[i]);
    p[CODE_LEN[i]] = 0xC3;
    St s; memcpy(&s, INIT + i*sizeof(St), sizeof(St));
    /* if pad != 0, esi is used as a POINTER (string instructions) */
    unsigned long long rsiv = s.pad ? (unsigned long long)(unsigned long)(s.mem + 64)
                                    : (unsigned long long)s.r[5];
    g_infault = 1;
    if (sigsetjmp(g_jb, 1) != 0){ g_infault = 0; continue; }   /* skip the case */
    run_one(&s, rsiv);
    g_infault = 0;
    printf("%u", i);
    for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) printf(" %08x", s.r[k]);
    printf(" %08x ", s.fl & 0x8D5u);
    for (int k = 0; k < @MEMSZ@; k++) printf("%02x", s.mem[k]);
    printf("\\n");
  }
  return 0;
}
"""

GUEST_HDR = """
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <math.h>
void mem_commit(uint32_t,uint32_t);
guest_fn_t g_dtab[DISPATCH_TEXT_SIZE];
void dispatch_indirect(CPU*c,uint32_t a){(void)c;(void)a;}
void unsupported_insn(CPU*c,uint32_t a,const char*m){(void)c;(void)a;(void)m;}
void guest_hook(CPU*c,uint32_t a){(void)c;(void)a;}
void cpuid_shim(CPU*c){(void)c;} uint64_t rdtsc_shim(void){return 0;}
"""

def gen_oracle(cases, chunks, workdir):
    blob = bytearray(); offs = []; lens = []
    for c in chunks:
        offs.append(len(blob)); lens.append(len(c)); blob += c
    init = bytearray()
    for cs in cases:
        init += struct.pack('<6III', *cs['regs'], cs['flags'],
                            1 if cs['ptr'] else 0) + cs['mem']
    o = [ORACLE_C.replace('@MEMSZ@', str(MEMSZ))]
    o.append('const unsigned NCASE = %d;' % len(cases))
    o.append('const unsigned char CODE[] = {' + ','.join(str(b) for b in blob) + '};')
    o.append('const unsigned CODE_OFF[] = {' + ','.join(map(str, offs)) + '};')
    o.append('const unsigned CODE_LEN[] = {' + ','.join(map(str, lens)) + '};')
    o.append('const unsigned char INIT[] = {' + ','.join(str(b) for b in init) + '};')
    src = os.path.join(workdir, 'oracle.c')
    open(src, 'w').write('\n'.join(o))
    exe = os.path.join(workdir, 'oracle')
    subprocess.run(['clang','-arch','x86_64','-O0','-o',exe,src], check=True)
    return exe

def gen_guest(cases, chunks, workdir):
    bodies = []; names = []; skipped = []
    for i, c in enumerate(chunks):
        L = RawLifter(bytes(c) + b'\xc3', base=BASE, comments=False)
        try:
            code, _ = L.lift(BASE)
        except Unsupported as e:
            names.append(None); skipped.append((i, str(e))); continue
        except Exception as e:
            names.append(None); skipped.append((i, 'ERROR: ' + str(e))); continue
        bodies.append(code.replace('sub_%08x' % BASE, 't%d' % i))
        names.append('t%d' % i)
    o = [GUEST_HDR, '\n'.join(bodies), 'static CPU cpu; static CPU *const c = &cpu;']
    o.append('int main(void){ mem_init(); mem_commit(0x0u,0x01000000u); mem_fault_handler_install();')
    o.append('  unsigned char m[%d];' % MEMSZ)
    for i, cs in enumerate(cases):
        if i >= len(names) or names[i] is None: continue
        regs = cs['regs']; f = cs['flags']
        o.append('  {')
        o.append('   memset(&cpu,0,sizeof cpu); cpu.esp=0x00B00000u; cpu.top=0; cpu.fcw=0x037f;')
        for k, rn in enumerate(['eax','ecx','edx','ebx','ebp','esi']):
            o.append('   cpu.%s=0x%08xu;' % (rn, regs[k]))
        if cs['ptr']:
            o.append('   cpu.esi=0x%08xu;' % (SCRATCH + 64))
        o.append('   cpu.edi=0x%08xu;' % SCRATCH)
        o.append('   cpu.cf=%d; cpu.pf=%d; cpu.af=%d;' % ((f>>0)&1, (f>>2)&1, (f>>4)&1))
        o.append('   cpu.zf=%d; cpu.sf=%d; cpu.of=%d; cpu.df=%d;' % ((f>>6)&1,(f>>7)&1,(f>>11)&1,(f>>10)&1))
        o.append('   static const unsigned char mi[%d]={%s};' % (MEMSZ, ','.join(str(b) for b in cs['mem'])))
        o.append('   memcpy(g_mem+0x%08xu, mi, %d);' % (SCRATCH, MEMSZ))
        o.append('   PUSH32(0xDEADC0DEu);')
        o.append('   %s(&cpu);' % names[i])
        o.append('   printf("%d");' % i)
        o.append('   printf(" %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x",'
                 ' cpu.eax,cpu.ecx,cpu.edx,cpu.ebx,cpu.ebp,cpu.esi);')
        o.append('   { uint32_t fl = (cpu.cf?1u:0)|(cpu.pf?4u:0)|(cpu.af?0x10u:0)'
                 '|(cpu.zf?0x40u:0)|(cpu.sf?0x80u:0)|(cpu.of?0x800u:0);')
        o.append('     printf(" %08x ", fl); }')
        o.append('   memcpy(m, g_mem+0x%08xu, %d);' % (SCRATCH, MEMSZ))
        o.append('   for(int k=0;k<%d;k++) printf("%%02x", m[k]);' % MEMSZ)
        o.append('   printf("\\n");')
        o.append('  }')
    o.append('  return 0; }')
    src = os.path.join(workdir, 'guest.c')
    open(src, 'w').write('\n'.join(o))
    exe = os.path.join(workdir, 'guest')
    subprocess.run(['clang','-O1','-Wno-unused-label','-Iruntime','-o',exe,src,
                    'runtime/mem.c','-lm'], check=True)
    return exe, skipped

def main():
    n    = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 2000
    seed = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 12345
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    workdir = os.environ.get('FUZZDIR', '/tmp/fuzzisa')
    os.makedirs(workdir, exist_ok=True)

    cases = []; asm = []
    for i in range(n):
        t = T[i % len(T)] if i < len(T) else rng.choice(T)
        a = t.gen(rng)
        asm.append(a)
        regs = [rng.getrandbits(32) for _ in range(6)]
        for k in range(6):
            if rng.random() < 0.35:
                regs[k] = rng.choice([0,1,2,0xFFFFFFFF,0x80000000,0x7FFFFFFF,
                                      rng.randrange(0,64), rng.randrange(0,4)])
        mem = bytearray(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(MEMSZ))
        for off in range(0, 64, 4):
            if rng.random() < 0.7:
                v = rng.choice([0.0,1.0,-1.0,0.5,2.0,3.7,-3.7,1e-3,1e6,
                                rng.uniform(-100,100)])
                struct.pack_into('<f', mem, off, v)
        flags = 0x202 | (rng.getrandbits(12) & 0x8D5)
        cases.append(dict(regs=regs, mem=bytes(mem), flags=flags, tmpl=t.name,
                          undef=t.undef, skipmem=t.skipmem, ptr=t.ptr, asm=a))

    chunks = assemble(asm, workdir)
    with open(os.path.join(workdir,'cases.txt'),'w') as fh:
        for i,(a,ch) in enumerate(zip(asm,chunks)):
            fh.write('%d\t%s\t%s\n' % (i, ch.hex(), a.replace(chr(10),' ; ').replace(chr(9),'')))
    oexe = gen_oracle(cases, chunks, workdir)
    gexe, skipped = gen_guest(cases, chunks, workdir)

    ro = subprocess.run([oexe], capture_output=True, text=True)
    rg = subprocess.run([gexe], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if ro.returncode: print('  WARNING: oracle exit code %d' % ro.returncode)
    if rg.returncode: print('  WARNING: guest exit code %d  %s' % (rg.returncode, rg.stderr[:200]))
    def parse(lines):
        d = {}
        for l in lines:
            f = l.split()
            if len(f) == 9: d[f[0]] = f[1:]
        return d
    om = parse(ro.stdout.splitlines())
    gm = parse(rg.stdout.splitlines())

    bad = {}; checked = 0
    for i in range(n):
        k = str(i)
        if k not in gm or k not in om: continue
        checked += 1
        o, g = om[k], gm[k]
        undef = cases[i]['undef']
        diffs = []
        for j, nm in enumerate(['eax','ecx','edx','ebx','ebp','esi']):
            if nm == 'esi' and cases[i]['ptr']: continue   # the base address differs
            if o[j] != g[j]: diffs.append('%s: real %s != ours %s' % (nm, o[j], g[j]))
        of_ = int(o[6],16) & ~undef; gf_ = int(g[6],16) & ~undef
        if of_ != gf_: diffs.append('flags: real %03x != ours %03x' % (of_, gf_))
        if o[7] != g[7] and not cases[i]['skipmem']:
            for b in range(MEMSZ):
                a1, b1 = o[7][b*2:b*2+2], g[7][b*2:b*2+2]
                if a1 != b1:
                    diffs.append('mem[%d]: real %s != ours %s' % (b, a1, b1)); break
        if diffs:
            inp = 'input: ' + ' '.join('%s=%08x' % (n, v) for n, v in
                     zip(['eax','ecx','edx','ebx','ebp','esi'], cases[i]['regs'])) \
                  + ' flags=%03x' % (cases[i]['flags'] & 0x8d5)
            bad.setdefault(cases[i]['tmpl'], []).append((i, cases[i]['asm'], [inp] + diffs))

    print('\n  checked: %d/%d   not liftable: %d' % (checked, n, len(skipped)))
    if skipped:
        seen = set()
        for i, e in skipped:
            if e in seen: continue
            seen.add(e); print('    no lift: %-28s example: %r' % (e, cases[i]['asm']))
    # Do NOT SAY "matched" if no case was checked: when the lifter crashed at
    # the start (0/n checked) this line came out green and hid the breakage.
    if not checked:
        print('  \033[31mNO CASE WAS CHECKED -- the result is void\033[0m'); return 1
    if not bad:
        print('  \033[32mALL RESULTS MATCH\033[0m'); return 0
    print('\n  \033[31m%d mismatches, in %d templates\033[0m'
          % (sum(len(v) for v in bad.values()), len(bad)))
    for tn, lst in sorted(bad.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1])):
        print('\n  --- %s  (%d cases) ---' % (tn, len(lst)))
        for i, a, d in lst[:2]:
            print('    #%d  %r' % (i, a))
            for x in d[:4]: print('        ' + x)
    return 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

  tools/gen_lan_race.py host|join [options] > script.txt

host: main menu -> LAN -> Host LAN Server (EA's server.dll) -> name -> LAN
      Main -> Select Car -> Lobby -> Create Game (mode, track, options) ->
      game room; waits for the joiners, clicks Start Race.
join: main menu -> LAN -> waits for the server list, joins the first server

      -> game room -> Ready.

hand the car to the game's own AI driver (script "autopilot on") and dump
frames until the end of the race, then the post-race screens.

Options:
  --name NAME          LAN name (host: also the server name)
  --car N              Select Car: N taps RIGHT (negative: LEFT) from the
                       first car (default 0: the first car)
  --mode N             Create Game: N taps RIGHT on the mode carousel
                       (0 Circuit, 1 Sprint, 2 Drag, 3 Street X? -- read the
                       dump "mode"; host only)
  --track N            N taps RIGHT on the track list (host only)
  --opt KEYS           taps on the options screen, e.g. "DOWN,DOWN,RIGHT";
                       "dump:LABEL" dumps a frame in between (host only)
  --wait-room MS       host: real time in the game room before Start Race
                       (joiners must be Ready by then; default 70000)
  --join-wait MS       join: real time at the server list (default 40000)
  --lobby-wait MS      join: real time in the lobby before Join Game

  --dump-every MS      race dump period (default 20000)
  --no-autopilot       keep the driver human (then nobody drives)
  --drag               drive with the synthetic pad (RT held, A = shift up

  --quit-mid MS        leave the race MS after the start (the process quits:

  --results-tmo N      frames to wait for the results screen (default 30000)
  --pause-at MS        open the in-race pause menu at MS (dumps), close it

                       the games that existed at this player's own search, so
                       a host that creates its game after the joiner entered
                       the lobby (a slow or loaded machine) is only seen then
  --confirm-join       join: answer Yes to the game's "connection quality is
                       below average ... Are you sure?" question (slow links)
  --fps N              the instance's frame rate (default 60): every frame
                       count in the script is scaled by N/60
  --leave-mid MS       leave the race MS after the start through the pause
                       menu ("Quit to LAN Main Menu"), stay online 43 s, quit
  --after LINES        extra script lines (';'-separated) appended after the
                       race start, e.g. for robustness scenarios
  --race-end LINES     script lines (';'-separated) after the race dumps
  --filter N           join: set the lobby Filter's Game Mode first (N taps
                       RIGHT from Circuit: 1 Sprint, 2 Drag, ...); the lobby
                       lists only games of that mode
  --churn N            join: join the game room and leave it (ESCAPE) N

  --lobby-churn N      join: leave the lobby for LAN Main and come back N
                       times first (robustness)
  --races N            N races in one session (default 1): after the
                       results everyone is back in the LAN Lobby; the host

                       (the screen keeps the previous laps, so --opt is not

"""

def race_again(w, a, host, r):
    """race r of the session: Continue from the results to the LAN Lobby,
    the host creates the next game, the joiners Refresh and join it"""
    x = f'_r{r}'
    w('+300  tap RETURN')
    w('+3000ms log continue-done')
    w(f'+0    log === race {r} ===')
    w('+6000ms log lobby')
    if host:

        w('+0    tap RETURN')
        w('+0    waitfng UI_QRModeSelect.fng 900')
        w(f'+260  dump mode{x}')
        w('+0    tap RETURN')
        w('+0    waitfng UI_QRTrackSelect.fng 900')
        w(f'+260  dump track{x}')
        w('+0    tap RETURN')
        w('+0    waitfng UI_QRModeOptions.fng 900')
        w(f'+260  dump options{x}')
        w('+0    tap RETURN')
        w('+0    waitfng PC_OL_GameRoom.fng 900')
        w(f'+300  dump room_0{x}')
        w(f'+{a.wait_room}ms dump room_1{x}')
        w('+0    log start-race')
        w('+0    click 0.311 0.172')
        w(f'+3000ms dump start{x}')
    else:
        # the host needs time to create its game; the list is only filled by
        # this player's own search: Refresh (third button), then Join Game
        w(f'+{a.lobby_wait + 10000}ms dump lobby{x}')
        w('+0    log refresh')
        w('+0    tap RIGHT')
        w('+40   tap RIGHT')
        w('+60   tap RETURN')
        w(f'+3000ms dump refreshed{x}')
        w('+0    log join-game')
        w('+0    tap LEFT')
        w('+60   tap RETURN')
        if a.confirm_join:
            w(f'+240  dump join_quality{x}')
            w('+0    tap LEFT')
            w('+40   tap RETURN')
        w('+0    waitfng PC_OL_GameRoom.fng 900')
        w(f'+300  dump room_0{x}')
        w('+0    log ready')
        w('+0    click 0.311 0.172')
        w(f'+3000ms dump room_ready{x}')
    race_start(w, a)
    t = 0
    while t < a.race_ms:
        step = min(a.dump_every, a.race_ms - t)
        t += step
        w(f'+{step}ms dump race_{t // 1000}{x}')
    w(f'+0    waitfng UI_PostRaceResults.fng {a.results_tmo}')
    w(f'+0    log results{x}')
    w(f'+180  dump results{x}')
    w(f'+3000ms dump results_2{x}')

def race_start(w, a):
    """from the game room to the race: wait for GameFlow 6, then drive"""
    w('+0    waitmem 0x008654a4 6 20000')
    w('+0    log race-loaded')
    w('+0    peek 0x00865558 1')
    if a.drag:
        # drag: the AI driver does not take a drag car; the synthetic pad
        # drives it (RT throttle held, A = shift up every 1.2 s)
        # throttle held through the intro and the countdown (revving);
        # shifts from about the start on
        w('+0    trigger RT 1')
        w('+0    wzero')
        w('+9000ms log race-start')
        w('+0    peek 0x00865558 1')
        for k in range(16):
            w('+1200ms tappad A')
    elif not a.no_autopilot:
        # the local player becomes a human driver at the race start
        # (Player::SetState): the autopilot waits for that
        w('+0    autopilot on 6000')
        w('+0    wzero')
        w('+0    log race-start')
        w('+0    peek 0x00865558 1')

def scale_frames(lines, k):
    """frame counts were written for 60 fps: scale "+N" delays (not "+Nms")
    and the frame arguments of tapuntil / waitfng / waitmem / autopilot"""
    if k == 1.0: return lines
    out = []
    for ln in lines:
        if ln.startswith('#'): out.append(ln); continue
        f = ln.split()
        if f and f[0].startswith('+') and f[0][1:].isdigit():
            f[0] = '+' + str(int(round(int(f[0][1:]) * k)))
        cmd = f[1] if len(f) > 1 else ''
        idx = {'tapuntil': (4, 5), 'waitfng': (3,), 'waitmem': (4,), 'autopilot': (3,)}.get(cmd, ())
        for i in idx:
            if i < len(f) and f[i].isdigit(): f[i] = str(int(round(int(f[i]) * k)))
        out.append(f[0].ljust(6) + ' ' + ' '.join(f[1:]) if f else ln)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate long input scripts for the memory/stability soaks (heap track).

  tools/gen_soak.py qrloop [N]      N Quick Race loads (default 20): race types
                                    Circuit, Sprint, Drift, Street X, URL in
                                    turn, ~15 s of driving, pause -> Quit to
                                    Main Menu.  "status load_K" after each.
  tools/gen_soak.py roam [MIN]      new career profile -> free roam with the
                                    game's autopilot for MIN minutes (default
                                    20); "status roam_K" every minute.
  tools/gen_soak.py resetloop [N]   N display-mode round trips (Options ->
                                    Display: one row down, apply, back to the
                                    native row, apply = 2 D3D Resets each).
  tools/gen_soak.py soak [MIN]      mixed soak for MIN minutes (default 95):
                                    career free roam (autopilot), quit to main
                                    menu, Quick Race loads of every type with
                                    restarts and quits, and a display-mode
                                    change (Options -> Display, D3D Reset)
                                    about every 10 minutes.

The script language is runtime/autotest.c's.  Frame counts assume ~120 fps
(the game caps there); everything that matters is synchronised on the
front-end package or the GameFlow state, not on time.
"""
import sys

QR_TYPES = [(0, "circuit"), (1, "sprint"), (3, "drift"), (4, "streetx"), (5, "url")]

def boot_no_profile(o):
    o.append("0     tapuntil RETURN MC_Background.fng 120 4000   # title -> profile prompt")
    o.append("+200  tap RETURN                                   # \"No\"")
    o.append("+0    waitfng GarageMain.fng 3000")
    o.append("+300  status menu_0")

def quit_to_menu(o, finished_ok=True):
    # pause -> last item (Quit to Main Menu; the carousel does not wrap) -> OK
    o.append("+0    tap ESCAPE")
    o.append("+120  tap RIGHT")
    for _ in range(5):
        o.append("+30   tap RIGHT")
    o.append("+60   tap RETURN")
    o.append("+120  tap LEFT")
    o.append("+60   tap RETURN")
    o.append("+0    waitfng GarageMain.fng 1500")
    # if the race had already ended (results screens), back out with ESC.
    # UI_Main, not GarageMain: GarageMain stays the top package on every
    # front-end page (Options included)
    o.append("+0    tapuntil ESCAPE UI_Main.fng 150 2400")

def menu_select(o, idx):
    # main menu carousel (Career, Quick Race, Online, LAN, Customize, Profile
    # Manager, Options: idx 0..6; Split Screen after Quick Race since
    # runtime/splitscreen.c); it remembers its position and does not wrap
    o.append("+0    tapuntil ESCAPE UI_Main.fng 150 2400")
    o.append("+300  tap LEFT")
    for _ in range(6):
        o.append("+40   tap LEFT")
    for _ in range(idx + (idx >= 2)):
        o.append("+40   tap RIGHT")
    o.append("+90   log main menu item %d" % idx)

def qr_race(o, k, label, drive=1800, restart=False):
    menu_select(o, 1)
    o.append("+0    tapuntil RETURN UI_QRModeSelect.fng 150 3000 # main menu -> Quick Race")
    o.append("+200  tap LEFT")
    for _ in range(5):
        o.append("+20   tap LEFT")                     # back to Circuit (no wrap)
    for _ in range(k):
        o.append("+30   tap RIGHT")
    o.append("+60   tapuntil RETURN PC_Loading.fng 120 4000      # track, options, car")
    o.append("+0    waitmem 0x8654a4 6 4000")
    o.append("+300  status race_%s" % label)
    o.append("+0    down UP")
    seg = drive // 3
    o.append("+%d  tap RIGHT 30" % seg)
    o.append("+%d  tap LEFT 30" % seg)
    o.append("+%d  up UP" % seg)
    o.append("+0    dump %s" % label)
    if restart:
        # pause -> Restart (second item) -> confirm
        o.append("+0    tap ESCAPE")
        o.append("+120  tap RIGHT")
        o.append("+60   tap RETURN")
        o.append("+120  tap LEFT")
        o.append("+60   tap RETURN")
        o.append("+0    waitmem 0x8654a4 6 4000")
        o.append("+300  status restart_%s" % label)
        o.append("+0    down UP")
        o.append("+600  up UP")
    quit_to_menu(o)
    o.append("+300  status load_%s" % label)

def career_roam(o, minutes, tag):
    # new profile, Start New Career, SMS, free roam with autopilot
    o.append("+0    tapuntil RETURN MC_Background.fng 120 4000")
    o.append("+120  tap LEFT")
    o.append("+30   tap RETURN")
    o.append("+240  tap BACK")

    o.append("+60   tap RETURN                      # Career")
    o.append("+300  tap RETURN                      # Start New Career")
    o.append("+0    waitfng UI_EngageMessageDialog.fng 6000")
    o.append("+300  tap RETURN                      # SMS: Continue")
    o.append("+0    waitfng HUD_SingleRace.fng 3000")
    o.append("+600  status roam_start")
    roam_minutes(o, minutes, tag)

def display_change(o, label):
    # Options -> Display -> resolution one row down and back up (two Resets)
    menu_select(o, 6)
    o.append("+0    tap RETURN                                   # Options")
    # categories Audio, Display, Gameplay, Player, Controls, EA Trax, Credits:
    # remembered, no wrap
    o.append("+300  tap LEFT")
    for _ in range(5):
        o.append("+40   tap LEFT")
    o.append("+40   tap RIGHT                                    # Display")
    o.append("+90   tap RETURN")
    o.append("+300  tap LEFT                                     # resolution row: one down")
    o.append("+90   tap ESCAPE                                   # leave -> apply?")
    o.append("+200  tap RETURN")
    o.append("+400  status reset_%s_a" % label)
    o.append("+0    tap RETURN")
    o.append("+300  tap RIGHT                                    # back to the native row")
    o.append("+90   tap ESCAPE")
    o.append("+200  tap RETURN")
    o.append("+400  status reset_%s_b" % label)
    o.append("+0    dump reset_%s" % label)
    o.append("+0    tapuntil ESCAPE UI_Main.fng 150 2400")

def qrloop(n):
    o = ["# Generated by tools/gen_soak.py qrloop %d: memory growth per race load." % n]
    boot_no_profile(o)
    for i in range(n):
        k, nm = QR_TYPES[i % len(QR_TYPES)]
        qr_race(o, k, "%d_%s" % (i + 1, nm))
    o.append("+60   quit")
    return o

def roam(minutes):
    o = ["# Generated by tools/gen_soak.py roam %d: career free roam with the game's autopilot." % minutes]
    career_roam(o, minutes, "roam")
    o.append("+300  status roam_end")
    o.append("+60   quit")
    return o

def resetloop(n):
    o = ["# Generated by tools/gen_soak.py resetloop %d: Metal memory across D3D Reset." % n]
    boot_no_profile(o)
    for i in range(n):
        display_change(o, "%d" % (i + 1))
        o.append("+300  status after_reset_%d" % (i + 1))
    o.append("+60   quit")
    return o

def roam_minutes(o, minutes, tag):
    o.append("+0    autopilot on")
    for m in range(minutes):
        o.append("+60000ms status %s_%d" % (tag, m + 1))
        if m % 5 == 4:
            o.append("+0    dump %s_%d" % (tag, m + 1))
        # an SMS or mailbox may have popped up (it pauses the world): back out
        # of it; no key is sent when the race HUD is on top
        o.append("+0    tapuntil ESCAPE HUD_SingleRace.fng 120 1200")
        o.append("+60   autopilot on                  # again, in case an event took the car back")
    o.append("+0    autopilot off")

def career_resume(o, minutes, tag):
    # main menu -> Career -> Resume Career -> free roam (autopilot)
    menu_select(o, 0)
    o.append("+0    tap RETURN                                   # Career")
    o.append("+300  tap RETURN                                   # Resume Career")
    o.append("+0    waitfng HUD_SingleRace.fng 4000")
    o.append("+600  status %s_start" % tag)
    roam_minutes(o, minutes, tag)

def soak(minutes):
    o = ["# Generated by tools/gen_soak.py soak %d: mixed long-session soak." % minutes]
    # 1) new career profile, free roam ~10 min, quit to the main menu
    career_roam(o, 10, "roam")
    quit_to_menu(o)
    o.append("+300  status career_quit")
    # 2) cycles (~13 min each): 2 x (5 Quick Race loads of every type, every
    #    4th with a restart, then a display-mode change = two D3D Resets),
    #    3 minutes of career free roam, quit to the main menu
    t = 12.0
    i = 0
    cyc = 0
    while t < minutes - 2:
        cyc += 1
        for blk in range(2):
            for k, nm in QR_TYPES:
                i += 1
                qr_race(o, k, "%d_%s" % (i, nm), restart=(i % 4 == 0))
            display_change(o, "%d%s" % (cyc, "ab"[blk]))
        career_resume(o, 3, "roam%d" % cyc)
        quit_to_menu(o)
        o.append("+300  status cycle_%d" % cyc)
        t += 13.5
    o.append("+300  status soak_end")
    o.append("+60   quit")
    return o

if __name__ == "__main__":
    what = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "qrloop"
    arg = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None
    lines = {"qrloop": lambda: qrloop(arg or 20), "roam": lambda: roam(arg or 20),
             "resetloop": lambda: resetloop(arg or 10), "soak": lambda: soak(arg or 95)}[what]()
    print("\n".join(lines))
